questions.q: In its bi-monthly monetary policy of 3-5 August 2026, the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee kept the policy repo rate unchanged. What are the policy repo rate and the Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) rate after this policy?
questions.explanation: On 5 Aug 2026 the MPC voted unanimously to hold repo at 5.25% with a neutral stance, its fourth straight pause. The corridor is SDF 5.00% and MSF/Bank Rate 5.50% (Business Standard / CNBC TV18, 5 Aug 2026).

questions.q: In the August 2026 monetary policy, how did the RBI revise its projections of real GDP growth and CPI inflation for FY 2026-27?
options: GDP lowered to 6.5%; CPI inflation raised to 5.2%
GDP retained at 6.6%; CPI inflation retained at 5.1%
GDP raised to 6.7%; CPI inflation lowered to 5.0%
GDP raised to 7.0%; CPI inflation lowered to 4.1%
questions.explanation: The 5 Aug 2026 policy raised the FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.7% and cut the FY27 CPI inflation forecast to 5.0% (New Indian Express / Moneycontrol / IIFL, 5 Aug 2026).

questions.q: Under the Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS), 2026, which came into effect on 1 July 2026, what is the maximum compensation the RBI Ombudsman can award for consequential loss, and for mental agony, harassment and expenses?
questions.explanation: RB-IOS 2026 took effect on 1 Jul 2026 and replaced RB-IOS 2021, which allowed Rs 20 lakh + Rs 1 lakh. It allows up to Rs 30 lakh for consequential loss plus Rs 3 lakh for non-financial loss, Rs 33 lakh in total (Business Standard 1 Jul 2026 / Economic Times 14 Jul 2026).

questions.q: Under the RBI's final framework for compensating victims of small-value digital frauds (net loss up to Rs 50,000), notified in June 2026 and effective from 1 January 2027, how much compensation does an eligible customer receive?
options: 85% of the net loss or Rs 25,000, whichever is lower
75% of the net loss or Rs 30,000, whichever is lower
100% of the net loss, up to Rs 50,000
50% of the net loss, up to Rs 25,000
questions.explanation: The RBI's final framework (24 Jun 2026) pays 85% of the net loss, capped at Rs 25,000, as a once-in-a-lifetime benefit, effective 1 Jan 2027 (Indian Express / Livemint, 24-25 Jun 2026).

questions.q: NPCI has announced a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on person-to-merchant (P2M) UPI transactions with effect from 15 October 2026. What is the MDR, and on transactions above what value does it apply?
questions.explanation: NPCI set a 0.4% MDR on P2M UPI payments above Rs 2,000 from 15 Oct 2026, capped at Rs 300 (reached at Rs 75,000). The Supreme Court refused to stay it on 28 Sep 2026 (Entrackr 15 Sep / Indian Express 28 Sep 2026).

questions.q: In August 2026, NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL) signed an agreement with National Interbank Processing Centre (NIPC), operator of the HUMO payment system, so that Indian travellers can pay with UPI by scanning the national QR code 'UZQR'. NIPC belongs to which country?
questions.explanation: NIPL partnered with Uzbekistan's NIPC (the HUMO operator) to accept UPI through UZQR. The deal was announced on 31 Aug 2026 and no rollout date has been set yet (Economic Times 31 Aug / MediaNama 1 Sep 2026).

questions.q: The RBI released the list of Upper Layer NBFCs (NBFC-UL) for 2026-27 on 6 August 2026. Which of the following is NOT one of the new entrants to the list?
questions.explanation: The FY27 NBFC-UL list grew to 17 entities. REC, PFC, IRFC and HUDCO were added, while Tata Sons stayed on from before (The Statesman 6 Aug / Adda247 7 Aug 2026).

questions.q: In September 2026, the Reserve Bank of India approved Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) to acquire an aggregate holding of up to 9.99% of the paid-up share capital or voting rights of which bank?
questions.explanation: The RBI approved LIC to acquire up to 9.99% of ICICI Bank, with one year to complete the acquisition (Business Standard / BusinessLine / Moneycontrol, 5 Sep 2026).

questions.q: The Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 2026, which comes into force on 1 October 2026, replaces the Bankers' Books Evidence Act of which year?
questions.explanation: The new Act takes effect on 1 Oct 2026 and replaces the 1891 law. It gives legal recognition to digital banking records (DD News / Business Standard 11 Sep 2026; Organiser 14 Sep 2026).

questions.q: Under the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Cybersecurity, Technology: Risk, Resilience and Assurance Framework) Directions, 2026, issued on 31 July 2026, within what time must a bank report a cyber security incident to the RBI on the DAKSH platform?
questions.explanation: The 31 Jul 2026 Directions require cyber incidents to be reported on DAKSH within six hours. Critical customer-facing systems need a vulnerability assessment every 6 months and a penetration test every 12 months (MediaNama, 3 Aug 2026).

questions.q: According to the RBI's Financial Stability Report (June 2026), what was the Gross Non-Performing Assets (GNPA) ratio of scheduled commercial banks in March 2026, a multi-decadal low?
questions.explanation: FSR June 2026: SCB GNPA fell to a multi-decadal low of 1.8% in Mar 2026, and stress tests show it could edge up to 1.9% by FY28 (Economic Times / Business Today, 30 Jun 2026).

questions.q: In May 2026, the RBI's Central Board approved a record surplus transfer to the Central Government for the accounting year 2025-26. What was the amount, approximately?
questions.explanation: On 22 May 2026 the RBI's Central Board approved a record Rs 2.87 lakh crore surplus transfer for FY26. FY25 was Rs 2.69 lakh crore and FY24 was Rs 2.11 lakh crore (Moneycontrol / DD News / ANI, 22 May 2026).

questions.q: Rohit Jain was appointed Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India for three years with effect from 3 May 2026. Whom did he succeed?
questions.explanation: The government appointed Rohit Jain as RBI Deputy Governor for 3 years from 3 May 2026 after T. Rabi Sankar's term ended (Business Standard / Economic Times, 2 May 2026).

questions.q: In July 2026, the Government of India approved an RBI proposal to put polymer (plastic) banknotes into field trials. Which denominations are included, with 1 billion notes of each?
questions.explanation: The government approved field trials of 1 billion each of Rs 10 and Rs 20 polymer notes (2 billion in total, about Rs 3,000 crore) and said there is no plan to replace paper notes (Indian Express / Economic Times, 27 Jul 2026).

questions.q: As per data released by the RBI in July 2026, what was the value of the composite Financial Inclusion Index (FI-Index) for March 2026?
questions.explanation: The FI-Index rose 4.48% to 70.0 in Mar 2026 from 67.0 in Mar 2025, led by the Usage sub-index. Its weights are Access 35%, Usage 45% and Quality 20% (ANI / Business Standard / Economic Times, 16 Jul 2026).

questions.q: Under the RBI's draft guidelines of August 2026 to restart 'on-tap' licensing of Urban Co-operative Banks (UCBs), what minimum deposit base must a credit co-operative society have to apply for conversion into a UCB?
questions.explanation: The 5 Aug 2026 draft requires deposits of at least Rs 10,000 crore and net worth of at least Rs 300 crore. It resumes UCB licensing after 22 years, and only three co-ops currently qualify (ET BFSI / Business Standard, 5 Aug 2026).

questions.q: The RBI cancelled the banking licence of Paytm Payments Bank Ltd with effect from 24 April 2026, and the Delhi High Court later ordered the bank to be wound up. Under which Act did the RBI cancel the licence?
questions.explanation: The RBI cancelled PPBL's licence on 24 Apr 2026 under Section 22(4) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949. In July 2026 the Delhi HC ordered winding up and appointed Girikumar M. Nair as Official Liquidator (The Hindu 24 Apr / Business Standard, Jul 2026).

questions.q: Under the RBI (Lending Against Gold and Silver Collateral) Directions, which took effect on 1 April 2026, what is the maximum Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio for a gold loan of up to Rs 2.5 lakh?
questions.explanation: The gold and silver collateral norms, effective 1 Apr 2026, set LTV at 85% for loans up to Rs 2.5 lakh, 80% for Rs 2.5-5 lakh and 75% above Rs 5 lakh (Indian Express 7 Jun 2025 / Upstox Apr 2026).

questions.q: The RBI has approved the appointment of Mahesh Muralidhar Pai, a Canara Bank veteran, as MD & CEO of which private sector bank for three years from 1 October 2026?
questions.explanation: The RBI approved Mahesh Muralidhar Pai as MD & CEO of South Indian Bank for 3 years from 1 Oct 2026 (BusinessLine / Economic Times, 8 Jul 2026).

questions.q: Which of the following statements about banking in India is INCORRECT?
options: From 1 April 2026, DICGC charges all insured banks a flat premium of 12 paise per Rs 100 of assessable deposits
The minimum maturity period of a Certificate of Deposit (CD) is 7 days
The Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) limit is USD 2,50,000 per financial year per resident individual
The Unique Transaction Reference (UTR) number of an RTGS transaction has 22 characters
questions.explanation: From 1 Apr 2026, DICGC charges a risk-based premium, from 8 paise per Rs 100 for the safest banks up to 12 paise, in place of the old flat 12 paise. The LRS, UTR and CD statements are correct (Economic Times / BusinessLine, 6-7 Feb 2026).

questions.q: According to the NSO data released on 31 August 2026, India's real GDP grew by how much in Q1 (April-June) of FY 2026-27?
questions.explanation: NSO/MoSPI, 31 Aug 2026 (The Hindu/Livemint/CNBC TV18): real GDP grew 7.8% in Q1 FY27, beating estimates. GVA grew 8.2%.

questions.q: India's CPI (retail) inflation for August 2026, released by MoSPI on 14 September 2026, was 4.82%. What is the base year of the new CPI series behind this figure?
questions.explanation: MoSPI/PIB press release, 14 Sep 2026: August 2026 CPI inflation was 4.82% (up from 4.45% in July) and food inflation 5.95%, on the new series with base 2024=100, which replaced the old 2012-base series.

questions.q: As per the Union Budget 2026-27 presented on 1 February 2026, what is the fiscal deficit target for FY 2026-27 as a share of GDP?
questions.explanation: Union Budget, 1 Feb 2026: the fiscal deficit target for FY27 is 4.3% of GDP (FY26 RE: 4.4%). Capex is Rs 12.2 lakh crore, and debt-to-GDP is to reach 50 +/- 1% by 2030-31.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a criterion for horizontal devolution of central taxes among states under the 16th Finance Commission (Chairman: Arvind Panagariya) for 2026-31?
questions.explanation: PRS summary of the 16th FC report, tabled 1 Feb 2026: states' share stays at 41%. 'Tax and fiscal effort' (2.5% under the 15th FC) was dropped, and the new 'contribution to GDP' criterion gets 10%. Income distance is 42.5%, population 17.5%, and demographic performance, area and forest are 10% each.

questions.q:
Consider these statements about the PM Surya Sarovar Yojana (PM-SSY), approved by the Union Cabinet on 31 July 2026:
I. Its total outlay is Rs 5,070 crore.
II. SECI is the implementing agency, under the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.
III. It targets 5,000 MW of floating solar PV with co-located storage of at least 2 hours.
Which of these statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Cabinet, 31 Jul 2026 (Insights IAS/StudyIQ/PIB): PM-SSY has an outlay of Rs 5,070 crore for 5,000 MW of floating solar with storage of at least 2 hours (10,000 MWh). CFA is Rs 1 crore per MW, MNRE is the nodal ministry and SECI implements the scheme.

questions.q: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of PM-KISAN from 2026-27 to 2030-31. What total financial outlay was approved for this period?
questions.explanation: Cabinet decision, 31 Jul 2026 (PMIndia/DD News): PM-KISAN continues to 2030-31 with an outlay of Rs 3.15 lakh crore. The benefit is Rs 6,000 a year, paid in 3 equal DBT instalments.

questions.q: On 16 September 2026, the Union Cabinet raised the wage ceiling for mandatory EPFO coverage from Rs 15,000 a month to how much?
questions.explanation: Cabinet, 16 Sep 2026 (The Hindu/Reuters/PIB): the ceiling rose to Rs 25,000 a month, bringing about 51 lakh more workers into coverage. It is the first hike in 12 years (Rs 15,000 since 2014). Rs 21,000 is the ESIC limit.

questions.q: The India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) came into force on 15 July 2026. Which other India-UK agreement took effect on the same day?
questions.explanation: DD India/PIB, Jul 2026: CETA and the Double Contribution Convention (the social security pact) both took effect on 15 Jul 2026. CETA gives duty-free access to about 99% of India's exports to the UK.

questions.q: Under the SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2026, approved at the SEBI board meeting on 24 September 2026, up to what share of client AUM can discretionary portfolio managers invest in unlisted investment-grade debt securities?
questions.explanation: SEBI board press release PR 59/2026, 24 Sep 2026: under DPMS, managers may invest up to 10% of client AUM in investment-grade, non-convertible unlisted debt, with client consent. The rules also allow IPO and foreign-security investments and create a Rs 25 lakh PRIM route for mutual funds.

questions.q: In June 2026, Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd (CPCL) was upgraded from Miniratna Category-I to Navratna status. Which number Navratna CPSE did it become?
questions.explanation: Govt order, 19 Jun 2026 (Economic Times/CNBC TV18): CPCL became India's 28th Navratna CPSE. A Navratna can invest up to Rs 1,000 crore or 15% of its net worth in one project without government approval.

questions.q: What was the theme of the 18th BRICS Summit held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi on 12-13 September 2026?
options: Strengthening Global South Cooperation for a More Inclusive and Sustainable Governance
Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability
Strengthening Multilateralism for Just Global Development and Security
BRICS and Africa: Partnership for Mutually Accelerated Growth, Sustainable Development and Inclusive Multilateralism
questions.explanation: PMIndia/DD News, Sep 2026: India hosted the 18th summit at Bharat Mandapam on 12-13 Sep 2026, its 4th chairship after 2012, 2016 and 2021, and the summit adopted the New Delhi Declaration. The other options are the themes of Brazil 2025, Russia 2024 and South Africa 2023.

questions.q: Sarnath (Uttar Pradesh) became India's 45th UNESCO World Heritage Site in July 2026. Where was the 48th session of the World Heritage Committee, at which it was inscribed, held?
questions.explanation: UNESCO/NDTV, 25 Jul 2026: Sarnath was inscribed at the 48th WHC session in Busan, the first held in Korea, after 28 years on the tentative list. The 46th session was held in New Delhi (2024) and the 47th in Paris (2025).

questions.q: At the 72nd National Film Awards, presented on 22 September 2026 at Ekta Nagar, Gujarat, who received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award?
questions.explanation: PIB/The Hindu, 22 Sep 2026: President Murmu presented the 72nd National Film Awards at Ekta Nagar, Kevadia. Anant Nag received the Phalke Award, and Article 370 won Best Feature Film. Mohanlal received the previous Phalke Award, at the 71st awards.

questions.q: In the UN SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2026, India recorded its best-ever rank in the SDG Index. What is that rank?
questions.explanation: SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2026 (Down To Earth/Manorama, Jun 2026): India rose to 94th, its highest ever, from 99th in 2025, when it first entered the top 100.

questions.q: What is India's rank in the World Economic Forum's Travel & Tourism Development Index (TTDI) 2026?
questions.explanation: WEF TTDI 2026 (Business Today, 26 Sep 2026): India rose 9 places, from 39th in 2024, to 31st of 110 economies with a score of 4.42. Japan took 1st place from the US.

questions.q: Who is India's richest person according to the M3M Hurun India Rich List 2026?
questions.explanation: M3M Hurun India Rich List 2026, released 23 Sep 2026: Gautam Adani & family overtook Mukesh Ambani with about Rs 9.23 lakh crore. Ambani is 2nd.

questions.q: Where did India finish in the medal table at the 2026 Commonwealth Games held in Glasgow?
questions.explanation: Glasgow CWG 2026 (Aug 2026): India finished 4th with 39 medals (13 gold, 17 silver, 9 bronze), including a record 7 boxing golds, even though wrestling and shooting were left out. Australia topped the table.

questions.q: Who were India's flag-bearers at the opening ceremony of the 20th Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan?
options: Manu Bhaker and Tajinderpal Singh Toor
questions.explanation: Sportstar/India Today, 19 Sep 2026: shooter Manu Bhaker and kabaddi captain Pawan Sehrawat led India. Sehrawat replaced Tajinderpal Singh Toor, who was named first. Harmanpreet and Lovlina carried the flag at Hangzhou 2022.

questions.q: Which country won the 2026 FIFA World Cup (hosted by the USA, Canada and Mexico) by beating Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final?
questions.explanation: CNBC/Indian Express, 19-20 Jul 2026: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time at MetLife Stadium, New Jersey, with an extra-time goal by Ferran Torres. It is Spain's 2nd title, after 2010.

questions.q: Economist Neelkanth Mishra was appointed India's Executive Director at the World Bank in June 2026. Besides India, which countries are in the constituency he represents?
questions.explanation: ACC approval, 4-5 Jun 2026 (ThePrint/BW People): Neelkanth Mishra was appointed for 3 years, succeeding Parameswaran Iyer. India's World Bank office (EDS12) represents India, Bangladesh, Bhutan and Sri Lanka.

questions.q: In September 2026, the Reserve Bank of India included which Vijayawada-headquartered Local Area Bank in the Second Schedule to the RBI Act, 1934, giving it scheduled bank status?
options: Krishna Bhima Samruddhi Local Area Bank
questions.explanation: An RBI notification of 4 Sep 2026 included Coastal Local Area Bank Ltd (Vijayawada) in the Second Schedule, giving it access to RBI liquidity facilities (GKToday / The Hans India, Sep 2026).

questions.q: In September 2026, the RBI allowed Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) to raise its holding to as much as 9.99% of the paid-up capital or voting rights of which bank, within one year?
questions.explanation: ICICI Bank received the RBI approval letter on 4 Sep 2026. LIC has one year to reach 9.99%; it held 4.35% as of 30 Jun 2026 (Business Standard, 5 Sep 2026).

questions.q: Under NPCI's revised framework (circular of 15 September 2026, effective 15 October 2026), what Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) will apply to Person-to-Merchant UPI transactions above ₹2,000 in the general merchant category?
questions.explanation: NPCI set 0.4% MDR on eligible P2M UPI payments above ₹2,000 from 15 Oct 2026, capped at ₹300 per transaction. Payments up to ₹2,000 and all P2P payments stay free (NPCI circular, 15 Sep 2026; Business Today).

questions.q: Who was appointed Executive Director of the Reserve Bank of India with effect from 1 September 2026, to oversee the Department of Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) and the Premises Department?
questions.explanation: The RBI promoted Suman Ray, previously its Regional Director for Maharashtra, to Executive Director from 1 Sep 2026 (RBI press release; Business Standard, 1 Sep 2026).

questions.q: The Finance Ministry has notified that the Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 2026 comes into force on 1 October 2026. It replaces the Bankers' Books Evidence Act of which year?
questions.explanation: The Ministry's notification of 10 Sep 2026 brings the new technology-neutral Act (Presidential assent 13 Aug 2026) into force from 1 Oct 2026, replacing the 1891 Act (Business Standard / DD News, 11 Sep 2026).

questions.q: At Global Fintech Fest 2026, the RBI launched multicurrency forex services on Bharat Connect, which is integrated with CCIL's FX-Retail platform. Which of the following currencies was NOT among the five added alongside the US dollar?
questions.explanation: The five currencies added were EUR, GBP, CAD, CHF and AED, in a soft launch at GFF 2026 in Mumbai (Business Today, 9 Sep 2026).

questions.q: NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL) partnered with FOMO Pay in September 2026 so that merchants in which country can accept UPI QR payments, with Resorts World Sentosa as the first merchant partner?
questions.explanation: The NIPL–FOMO Pay deal was announced at GFF 2026 on 9 Sep 2026. Indian tourists pay in INR and Singapore merchants settle in SGD (FOMO Pay / Macau Business, 9 Sep 2026).

questions.q: In September 2026, the Finance Ministry secured USD 1 billion from which institution to expand long-term MSME credit through SIDBI? Half came from the institution's own resources and half from a lender syndicate, swapped into rupees through the RBI's special swap window.
questions.explanation: The IFC provided USD 500 mn from its own resources and the other USD 500 mn is mobilised through a lender syndicate. SIDBI will on-lend to MSMEs for up to 7 years (KNN India, Sep 2026).

questions.q: In September 2026, the RBI issued final Directions on minimum capital requirements for market risk under the Basel III framework for commercial banks. From when do they take effect?
questions.explanation: The RBI (Commercial Banks – Minimum Capital Requirements for Market Risk) Directions, 2026, dated 21 Sep 2026, take effect on 1 Apr 2027. SFBs, payments banks and LABs are excluded (Business Standard / Adda247, Sep 2026).

questions.q: In the 40th edition of the Global Financial Centres Index (GFCI 40), released in September 2026 by Z/Yen Partners and the China Development Institute, what was GIFT City's overall global rank?
questions.explanation: GIFT City rose nine places, from 46th in GFCI 39 to 37th in GFCI 40, and entered the Asia-Pacific top 15 (Business Today / DD News, 17 Sep 2026).

questions.q: RBI data released on 11 September 2026 showed a record weekly jump of about USD 44.9 billion in India's foreign exchange reserves, taking them to a lifetime high for the week ended 4 September 2026. What was that level?
questions.explanation: Reserves reached USD 785.706 bn for the week ended 4 Sep 2026. Foreign currency assets rose USD 47.5 bn to USD 648.17 bn (RBI Weekly Statistical Supplement; Bloomberg, 11 Sep 2026).

questions.q: Which rating agency upgraded India's long-term sovereign rating from 'BBB+' to 'A-' with a Stable outlook on 2 September 2026, giving India an 'A'-category rating for the first time in about 35 years?
questions.explanation: JCR upgraded India to A- (Stable) on 2 Sep 2026 and raised the country ceiling to 'A', citing solid growth (7.8% in Q1 FY27) and improved financial-system soundness (ETV Bharat / ThePrint, 2 Sep 2026).

questions.q: The OECD's Interim Economic Outlook of September 2026 raised India's growth projection for FY2026-27 to:
questions.explanation: The OECD raised India's FY27 forecast by 0.8 percentage points, from 6.3% to 7.1%, and projected 6.5% for FY28 (OECD Interim Report, Sep 2026; Fibre2Fashion).

questions.q: According to NSO data released on 14 September 2026, what was India's CPI-based retail inflation for August 2026?
questions.explanation: CPI inflation rose to 4.82% in Aug 2026 from 4.45% in July. Food inflation was 5.95% and rural inflation 5.23% (NSO; APAC News Network, 14 Sep 2026).

questions.q: Gross GST collections for August 2026, released on 1 September 2026, grew 14.8% year-on-year to approximately:
questions.explanation: Gross GST revenue for August 2026 was ₹1,99,853 crore (+14.8%). Net revenue was ₹1.68 lakh crore (+8.3%) because refunds rose 67.9% (Business Standard / GSTN, 1 Sep 2026).

questions.q: By a Labour Ministry notification under the Code on Social Security, 2020, the EPFO wage ceiling was raised from ₹15,000 per month to what amount, effective 17 September 2026?
questions.explanation: Notification S.O. 5109(E) of 17 Sep 2026 set the ceiling at ₹25,000, the first increase since 2014, after Cabinet approval on 16 Sep. It is expected to bring over 51 lakh more workers under EPF (PMIndia / SCC Online, Sep 2026).

questions.q: The 18th BRICS Summit, held on 12–13 September 2026 under India's chairship, adopted the 'New Delhi Declaration'. At which venue was the summit held?
questions.explanation: Leaders met at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on 12–13 Sep 2026 and adopted the New Delhi Declaration (PIB / ANI / DD India, 12–13 Sep 2026).

questions.q: In the World Economic Forum's Travel & Tourism Development Index 2026, released in September 2026, what was India's rank?
questions.explanation: India rose nine places to 31st with a score of 4.42. Japan topped the index, knocking the US to second (WEF TTDI 2026; Business Today / Fortune India, 25–26 Sep 2026).

questions.q: What was India's rank in the WEF Global Gender Gap Index 2026, released in September 2026?
questions.explanation: India stayed unchanged at 131st of 145 countries, while Iceland retained the top spot (WEF GGGR 2026; The Hindu / Jagran Josh, 16–17 Sep 2026).

questions.q: The 2026 edition of the Indian Air Force's multinational air exercise 'Tarang Shakti', in which US F-35 fighters made their debut in an Indian exercise, began in late September 2026 at which Air Force Station?
questions.explanation: Tarang Shakti 2026 began its operational phase at AFS Jodhpur on 27 Sep 2026 with seven foreign air forces; about 40 countries are taking part or observing (DD News / Times of India, 27 Sep 2026).

questions.q: The 22nd edition of the India–US joint military exercise 'Yudh Abhyas', which began in September 2026 and was conducted simultaneously in two operational theatres, took place at:
options: Mahajan Field Firing Range (Rajasthan) and Auli
questions.explanation: Yudh Abhyas 2026 began in mid-Sep 2026 with about 600 troops from each side, training in the desert at Mahajan Field Firing Range, Rajasthan, and at high altitude in Auli, Uttarakhand (Times of India / The Statesman, 15–16 Sep 2026).

questions.q: Which veteran actor received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award from President Droupadi Murmu at the 72nd National Film Awards in Ekta Nagar (Kevadia), Gujarat, on 22 September 2026?
questions.explanation: President Murmu conferred the Dadasaheb Phalke Award on Anant Nag at the 72nd National Film Awards in Ekta Nagar, Gujarat (PIB / The Hindu, 22 Sep 2026).

questions.q: India won a record-extending eighth Women's Asia Cup title (2026, T20 format) on 13 September 2026 in Dubai. Which team did India beat in the final?
questions.explanation: India made 183/5 and beat defending champions Sri Lanka by 72 runs; Shafali Verma scored 68 and Shree Charani took 4/20 (ICC / ANI / The Indian Express, 13 Sep 2026).

questions.q: Who did World Bank Group President Ajay Banga name on 16 September 2026 as the World Bank Group's next Chief Economist and Senior Vice President for Development Economics?
questions.explanation: The World Bank named Michael Kremer, joint winner of the 2019 Nobel Prize in Economics, as Chief Economist from October 2026 (Reuters, 16 Sep 2026).

questions.q: World Tourism Day 2026 was observed on 27 September, with El Salvador as the official host country. What was its theme?
options: Digital Agenda and Artificial Intelligence to Redesign Tourism
questions.explanation: UN Tourism's 2026 theme was 'Digital Agenda and Artificial Intelligence to Redesign Tourism', with El Salvador as official host (Hospitalitynet / Andaman Chronicle, 23–27 Sep 2026).

questions.q: The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of the Reserve Bank of India, in its review concluded on 5 August 2026, kept the policy repo rate unchanged at:
questions.explanation: The MPC (3-5 Aug 2026) unanimously held repo at 5.25% with a neutral stance, its fourth straight pause, and raised the FY27 GDP projection to 6.7% (RBI policy, 5 Aug 2026; Business Standard/CNBC TV18).

questions.q: At the post-policy press conference on 5 August 2026, RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said India expects to introduce polymer (plastic) banknotes, subject to field trials, from:
questions.explanation: Malhotra said polymer ₹10 and ₹20 notes could enter circulation from early FY28 (around April 2027) if the pilot succeeds (RBI briefing, 5 Aug 2026; Business Standard/Business Today).

questions.q: Monisha Chakraborty, appointed Executive Director of the RBI with effect from 3 August 2026, has been given charge of which departments?
options: Foreign Exchange Department and Financial Markets Regulation Department
Department of Supervision and Department of Regulation
Consumer Education and Protection Department and Department of Communication
Department of Currency Management and Department of Payment and Settlement Systems
questions.explanation: The RBI appointed Monisha Chakraborty ED from 3 Aug 2026 to oversee the Foreign Exchange Department and the Financial Markets Regulation Department (RBI press release, 3 Aug 2026; Business Standard/BusinessLine).

questions.q: In August 2026, the Central Government appointed which former ISRO Chairman as a part-time non-official director on the Central Board of the Reserve Bank of India for four years?
questions.explanation: Ex-ISRO chief S. Somanath was appointed to the RBI Central Board and Anand Mahindra was reappointed for another four-year term (Moneycontrol/Business Standard, 20-21 Aug 2026).

questions.q: RBI's list of NBFCs in the Upper Layer (NBFC-UL) for 2026-27, released in August 2026, contains how many NBFCs?
questions.explanation: The RBI expanded the Upper-Layer NBFC list to 17 for FY27, adding REC, PFC, IRFC and HUDCO and keeping Tata Sons on it (The Statesman, 6 Aug 2026; Adda247, 7 Aug 2026).

questions.q: Under RBI's draft framework (August 2026) for on-tap licensing of new Urban Co-operative Banks, a credit co-operative society seeking conversion into a UCB must have a minimum deposit base of:
questions.explanation: The draft on-tap UCB licensing norms, which end a 22-year freeze on new licences, require deposits of ₹10,000 crore and net worth of ₹300 crore (RBI draft, 5 Aug 2026; Business Standard/ET BFSI).

questions.q: On 14 August 2026, RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹59.20 lakh on which bank for non-compliance with directions relating to 'Interest Rate on Deposits' and 'Securitisation of Standard Assets'?
questions.explanation: The RBI fined IndusInd Bank ₹59.2 lakh for violations of its deposit-interest and securitisation directions (RBI press release, 14 Aug 2026; CNBC TV18/Business Standard).

questions.q: Who has been named Chairperson of Airtel Payments Bank for a three-year term from 1 October 2026, succeeding Sunil Bharti Mittal?
questions.explanation: Former World Bank professional Shabnam Sinha was named Airtel Payments Bank chairperson from 1 Oct 2026 for three years, subject to RBI approval, succeeding Sunil Mittal (Business Standard/Moneycontrol, 17 Aug 2026).

questions.q: 'PosTransfer', a UPI-powered cross-border remittance service to India launched in August 2026 in partnership with India Post and the Universal Postal Union (UPU), was introduced by the postal service of which country?
questions.explanation: Qatar Post launched PosTransfer so Indians in Qatar can send money home to UPI IDs, in partnership with India Post and the UPU (The Peninsula, 15 Aug 2026; DD India/Firstpost, 17 Aug 2026).

questions.q: The Bankers' Books Evidence Bill, 2026, passed by Parliament in August 2026 to give legal recognition to electronic and digital banking records, replaces the Bankers' Books Evidence Act of which year?
questions.explanation: Parliament passed the Bill (Rajya Sabha, 10 Aug 2026), replacing the 135-year-old Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 1891 (The Hindu/Livemint/DD India, 10 Aug 2026).

questions.q: As per NSO data released on 31 August 2026, India's real GDP growth for Q1 (April-June) of FY 2026-27 was:
questions.explanation: The NSO's first estimate put Q1 FY27 real GDP growth at 7.8% on the new 2022-23 base series (NSO/MoSPI, 31 Aug 2026; The Statesman/BW Businessworld).

questions.q: India's all-India CPI (combined) inflation for July 2026, released by MoSPI on 12 August 2026 under the new series (base 2024=100), stood at:
questions.explanation: Retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July 2026 from 4.38% in June; food inflation was 5.52% (MoSPI CPI release, 12 Aug 2026; ETV Bharat/Financial Express).

questions.q: Gross GST collections for July 2026, released on 1 August 2026, stood at approximately:
questions.explanation: Gross GST collections grew 15.4% YoY to over ₹2.11 lakh crore in July 2026 (Govt data, 1 Aug 2026; The Hindu/Economic Times).

questions.q: According to RBI data released on 28 August 2026, India's foreign exchange reserves rose by $12.4 billion to a then all-time high for the week ended 21 August 2026. The reserves stood at:
questions.explanation: Forex reserves jumped $12.42 bn to a record $729.33 bn for the week ended 21 Aug 2026, driven by FCNR(B) inflows; the next week they rose to $740.8 bn (RBI WSS; Times of India/Business Standard, 28 Aug 2026).

questions.q: In August 2026, the Government launched an Offer for Sale (OFS) of up to 6.5% stake in Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC). What was the floor price per share?
questions.explanation: The Government's LIC OFS for up to 6.5% (including green shoe) opened on 4 Aug 2026 (retail 5 Aug) at a floor price of ₹382 per share (Upstox/CNBC TV18, 4 Aug 2026).

questions.q: In August 2026, SEBI introduced an 'IT Resilience Index (ITRI)' to assess the IT systems of:
options: Asset Management Companies of mutual funds
Market Infrastructure Institutions such as stock exchanges, depositories and clearing corporations
questions.explanation: A SEBI circular introduced the IT Resilience Index and an Early Warning System for Market Infrastructure Institutions: stock exchanges, clearing corporations and depositories (The Hindu/Business Standard/Moneycontrol, 24 Aug 2026).

questions.q: Who took charge as the Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog in August 2026, succeeding B.V.R. Subrahmanyam?
questions.explanation: Anurag Jain (IAS 1989, MP cadre, ex-MP Chief Secretary) was appointed for two years on 22 Jul 2026 and took charge on 17 Aug 2026 (DD India/Livemint, 17 Aug 2026; Business Standard, 18 Aug 2026).

questions.q: Kerala was officially renamed 'Keralam' in August 2026 after Parliament passed a law to that effect. Under which Article of the Constitution does Parliament have the power to alter the name of a State?
questions.explanation: Article 3 lets Parliament alter a State's name; the Centre notified 'Keralam' as Kerala's official name on 25 Aug 2026 (The Hindu/Times of India, 25 Aug 2026).

questions.q: Which country won the FIH Men's Hockey World Cup 2026, defeating Spain 1-0 in the final in August 2026?
questions.explanation: Germany beat Spain 1-0 with Michel Struthoff's 44th-minute goal to retain the title, their fourth, equalling Pakistan's record; Argentina won the women's title over the Netherlands on a shootout (FIH/Olympics.com, 30 Aug 2026).

questions.q: In August 2026, which Indian Grandmaster became the first Indian to win the Grand Chess Tour by defeating Fabiano Caruana 15-13 in the GCT Finals?
questions.explanation: R. Praggnanandhaa came back from a 0-6 deficit to beat Caruana 15-13 and become the first Indian GCT champion (FIDE/The Hindu/Chess.com, 28 Aug 2026).

questions.q: The 15th edition of Exercise MAITREE (MAITREE-XV), which began on 18 August 2026, is a joint military exercise between India and:
questions.explanation: MAITREE-XV is the India-Thailand army exercise; an 85-member Indian contingent left on 17 Aug 2026 for counter-terrorism training in jungle and semi-urban terrain (PIB/ThePrint, 17 Aug 2026).

questions.q: Indian theoretical physicist Deepak Dhar was named in August 2026 as a recipient of the Dirac Medal, which is awarded by:
options: International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP), Trieste
questions.explanation: ICTS professor Deepak Dhar, known for the Abelian sandpile model, was named a 2026 ICTP Dirac Medal recipient alongside Haim Sompolinsky and others (ICTP announcement, 8 Aug 2026; The Hindu/EurekAlert).

questions.q: During PM Narendra Modi's State Visit to Uzbekistan in August 2026, when India-Uzbekistan ties were elevated to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, which Uzbek state honour was conferred on him?
options: Order of St. Andrew the Apostle
questions.explanation: Uzbekistan conferred its highest honour, the Order of Oliy Darajali Do'stlik, on PM Modi; ties were upgraded to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with a $5 bn trade target (The Hindu/PMIndia joint statement, 30 Aug 2026).

questions.q: The 17th Conference of the Parties (COP17) to the UN Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) was held from 17 to 28 August 2026 in:
questions.explanation: UNCCD COP17 met in Ulaanbaatar from 17 to 28 Aug 2026 ('Restoring Land, Restoring Hope'), with Bhupender Yadav representing India; COP16 was held in Riyadh (UNCCD/PIB, Aug 2026).

questions.q: What was the theme of International Youth Day observed on 12 August 2026?
options: From Clicks to Progress: Youth Digital Pathways for Sustainable Development
Local Youth Actions for the SDGs and Beyond
Green Skills for Youth: Towards a Sustainable World
questions.explanation: The IYD 2026 theme is 'Different Contexts, Common Aspirations'; the other options are the 2025, 2024 and 2023 themes (UN, 12 Aug 2026).

questions.q: The Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS), 2026 came into effect on 1 July 2026. Up to what amount can the RBI Ombudsman now award for consequential loss, not counting the separate award for harassment and loss of time?
questions.explanation: RB-IOS 2026 (effective 1 Jul 2026) raised the cap from ₹20 lakh to ₹30 lakh, plus up to ₹3 lakh for loss of time, expenses and harassment (RBI RB-IOS 2026; Canara Bank salient features).

questions.q: In July 2026 the Delhi High Court, acting on RBI's plea, ordered Paytm Payments Bank to be wound up. Who was appointed its Official Liquidator?
questions.explanation: Girikumar M. Nair, a former SBI Chief General Manager, was named Official Liquidator (HC orders of 8 and 22 Jul 2026). RBI had cancelled the bank's licence on 24 Apr 2026 (Business Today, 28 Jul 2026).

questions.q: On 29 July 2026, SBI raised ₹4,691 crore through Basel III-compliant Additional Tier-1 (AT-1) perpetual bonds. What coupon rate did the bonds carry?
questions.explanation: The AT-1 issue, SBI's first of FY27, carried a 7.75% coupon with a call option after 5 years; it opened and closed on 29 Jul 2026 and was allotted on 30 Jul 2026 (Business Standard / PSU Connect, Jul 2026).

questions.q: In July 2026, RBI approved Mahesh Muralidhar Pai, a Chief General Manager at Canara Bank, as MD & CEO of which private sector bank for three years?
questions.explanation: RBI's letter of 7 Jul 2026 approved Pai as South Indian Bank MD & CEO for 3 years from 1 Oct 2026 (Business Standard, 8 Jul 2026).

questions.q: In July 2026, the Centre told Parliament it had approved RBI's proposal to field-trial polymer (plastic) banknotes. Which denominations are part of the trial?
questions.explanation: The Centre cleared a field trial of ₹10 and ₹20 polymer notes, one billion pieces of each; MoS Finance gave the written reply in the Lok Sabha on 27 Jul 2026 (AIR News / Testbook, Jul 2026).

questions.q: In tie-ups reported on 1 July 2026, NPCI partnered with which two banks to offer real-time foreign exchange rates and settlement for UPI payments made by Indians travelling abroad?
options: HSBC India and J.P. Morgan Payments
questions.explanation: NPCI signed separate tie-ups with HSBC India and J.P. Morgan Payments to provide real-time FX via API integration for cross-border UPI (J.P. Morgan release, 30 Jun 2026; Business Standard, 1 Jul 2026).

questions.q: Which Indian bank received its first international issuer credit rating, 'BBB-/Stable' (investment grade), from S&P Global Ratings in July 2026?
questions.explanation: S&P gave Federal Bank an inaugural BBB-/Stable long-term and A-3 short-term issuer rating (Business Standard, 9 Jul 2026).

questions.q: Ravi Shankar became an Executive Director of RBI on 1 July 2026. Which department does he oversee?
options: Department of Statistics and Information Management
Department of Payment and Settlement Systems
questions.explanation: Ravi Shankar oversees the Department of Statistics and Information Management (DSIM), where he was earlier Adviser-in-Charge (RBI appointment w.e.f. 1 Jul 2026; BusinessLine / Elets BFSI).

questions.q: RBI issued its Cybersecurity, Technology: Risk, Resilience and Assurance Framework Directions, 2026 on 31 July 2026. Within how many hours of detection must regulated entities report a cyber incident to RBI through the DAKSH platform?
questions.explanation: The directions (seven parallel sets, one per entity class, issued 31 Jul 2026) require cyber incidents to be reported within 6 hours of detection on RBI's DAKSH platform, with CERT-In also notified (KPMG India, Sep 2026; DSCI brief).

questions.q: In July 2026, NPCI raised the per-transaction limit for approving UPI payments with on-device biometrics (fingerprint or face) instead of the UPI PIN. What is the new limit?
questions.explanation: NPCI circular OC-226A of 3 Jul 2026 raised the biometric limit from ₹5,000 to ₹10,000 per transaction, effective 7 Aug 2026 (NPCI circular; news reports, Jul 2026).

questions.q: In its World Economic Outlook Update of July 2026, what did the IMF project as India's GDP growth for FY2026-27?
questions.explanation: The IMF trimmed India's FY27 forecast to 6.4% from 6.5% in April and raised FY28 to 6.7% (IMF WEO Update, 8 Jul 2026; Business Today / DD India).

questions.q: According to MoSPI data released on 13 July 2026, what was India's all-India CPI-based retail inflation for June 2026?
questions.explanation: June 2026 CPI inflation (base 2024=100) was 4.38%, up from 3.93% in May; food inflation was 5.32% and rural inflation 4.74% (MoSPI press release, 13 Jul 2026).

questions.q: Gross GST collections for June 2026, released on 1 July 2026, were about ₹1.95 lakh crore. What was the year-on-year growth?
questions.explanation: Gross GST was ₹1,94,812 crore, up 13.9% from ₹1,71,105 crore in June 2025; net GST grew 11.2% to ₹1,62,377 crore (GST data, 1 Jul 2026; TaxGuru).

questions.q: MoSPI released India's first-ever Index of Services Production (ISP) in July 2026. What is its base year?
questions.explanation: The trial ISP has base year 2024-25 and covers 19 formal service sub-sectors (~60% of services); the first release, for April 2026, came on 14 Jul 2026 (PIB / MoSPI, Jul 2026).

questions.q: On 15 July 2026, what outlay did the Union Cabinet approve for India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) 2.0?
questions.explanation: The Cabinet approved ISM 2.0 with about ₹1.27 lakh crore (vs ₹76,000 crore for ISM 1.0); the same day it cleared phase 2 of the mobile phone manufacturing scheme at ₹62,500 crore (Business Standard, 15 Jul 2026).

questions.q: PM Modi launched the Modified UDAN scheme at Jodhpur on 4 July 2026. It runs from FY2026-27 to FY2035-36. What is its total outlay?
questions.explanation: Modified UDAN has ₹28,840 crore over 10 years and targets 100 new aerodromes and 200 helipads (Cabinet approval, 25 Mar 2026; Business Standard, 4 Jul 2026).

questions.q: Which state topped NITI Aayog's first-ever Investment Friendliness Index (IFI) 2026, released in July 2026?
questions.explanation: Gujarat ranked first with 56.6, ahead of Maharashtra (53.7) and Tamil Nadu (53.3); the index uses 84 indicators across eight pillars (NITI Aayog; Drishti IAS, Jul 2026).

questions.q: In July 2026, the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet approved which IAS officer as CEO of NITI Aayog for two years, succeeding B.V.R. Subrahmanyam?
questions.explanation: The ACC approved Anurag Jain (1989-batch IAS, MP cadre, then Madhya Pradesh Chief Secretary) in July 2026; he took charge in mid-August 2026 (Business Standard, 22 Jul and 18 Aug 2026).

questions.q: The Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath was added to the UNESCO World Heritage List in July 2026. What number World Heritage Site is it for India?
questions.explanation: Sarnath was inscribed on 25 Jul 2026 at the 48th World Heritage Committee session in Busan, Republic of Korea, making it India's 45th site (UNESCO / PIB, Jul 2026).

questions.q: In July 2026, PM Narendra Modi became the second Indian PM after Jawaharlal Nehru to receive the 'Bintang Adipurna'. Which country's highest state honour is it?
questions.explanation: President Prabowo Subianto conferred the Bintang Republik Indonesia Adipurna on Modi in Jakarta on 7 Jul 2026 (Indonesian State Secretariat / Tempo, Jul 2026).

questions.q: On which date did the India–UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) and the Double Contribution Convention enter into force?
questions.explanation: Both came into force on 15 Jul 2026; CETA was signed on 24 Jul 2025 and the DCC on 10 Feb 2026 (PIB, Jul 2026).

questions.q: Which country won the 2026 FIFA World Cup by beating Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final on 19 July 2026?
questions.explanation: Spain won 1-0 after extra time with a 106th-minute Ferran Torres goal, its second title after 2010 (FIFA / ESPN, 19 Jul 2026).

questions.q: Which film was named Best Feature Film at the 72nd National Film Awards, announced on 18 July 2026?
questions.explanation: 'Article 370' won Best Feature Film and 'Kalki 2898 AD' won Best Popular Feature Film (72nd NFA announcement, 18 Jul 2026; awards presented 22 Sep 2026).

questions.q: The BIMCO–ICS Seafarer Workforce Report 2026 ranks India as the world's second-largest supplier of seafarers, with a 12.16% share. Which country ranks first?
questions.explanation: India supplies 3,11,936 seafarers (12.16%), behind only the Philippines; India's share was 5.2% in 2015 (PIB / ANI, 28 Jul 2026).

questions.q: DRDO flight-tested 'Kusha' for the first time on 23 July 2026 from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha. What kind of weapon is it?
questions.explanation: Kusha is an indigenous long-range surface-to-air missile (LR-SAM), part of the layered air defence envisaged under Mission Sudarshan Chakra (MoD / Business Today, 23-24 Jul 2026).

questions.q: At its meeting held on August 3-5, 2026, the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of RBI kept the policy repo rate unchanged at:
questions.explanation: Aug 5, 2026 (62nd MPC): repo held unanimously at 5.25% with a neutral stance, the fourth straight pause after the Dec 2025 cut (RBI MPC resolution).

questions.q: With the policy repo rate at 5.25%, the Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) rate and the Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) rate currently stand at:
questions.explanation: SDF = repo minus 25 bps (5.00%); MSF and Bank Rate = repo plus 25 bps (5.50%). All were unchanged in the Feb, Apr, Jun and Aug 2026 policies (RBI resolutions).

questions.q: In the August 2026 monetary policy, RBI revised its real GDP growth projection for 2026-27 to:
questions.explanation: Aug 2026: FY27 GDP projection raised to 6.7% from 6.6% (June). Quarterly path: Q1 7.0%, Q2 6.4%, Q3 6.5%, Q4 6.8% (RBI MPC resolution).

questions.q: As per the August 2026 MPC resolution, CPI inflation for 2026-27 is projected at:
questions.explanation: Aug 2026: FY27 CPI projection lowered to 5.0% from 5.1% (June). The 4.3% figure is the core inflation projection (RBI MPC resolution).

questions.q: According to RBI's August 2026 projections, in which quarter of 2026-27 is headline CPI inflation expected to peak, at about 5.9%?
questions.explanation: Aug 2026 path: Q2 4.7%, Q3 5.9%, Q4 5.5%. RBI said inflation will peak in Q3, mainly because of food and fuel (RBI MPC resolution).

questions.q: The MPC meeting held from August 3 to 5, 2026 was which meeting of RBI's Monetary Policy Committee since it was constituted?
questions.explanation: Feb 2026 was the 59th meeting, April the 60th, June the 61st and August 2026 the 62nd. The next meeting is scheduled for Oct 5-7, 2026 (RBI resolutions).

questions.q: In its June 2026 policy review, RBI cut its real GDP growth forecast for 2026-27 from 6.9% to:
questions.explanation: June 5, 2026 (61st MPC): FY27 growth cut to 6.6% (Q1 6.6, Q2 6.3, Q3 6.5, Q4 6.8), citing high energy prices and supply disruptions from the West Asia conflict (RBI resolution).

questions.q: In June 2026, RBI raised its CPI inflation projection for 2026-27 to:
questions.explanation: June 2026: FY27 CPI projection raised to 5.1% from 4.6% (April), with the sub-normal monsoon forecast and El Nino risk flagged. Core inflation projected at 4.7% (RBI resolution).

questions.q: In its first bi-monthly policy of FY 2026-27 (April 8, 2026), RBI projected real GDP growth and CPI inflation for 2026-27, respectively, at:
questions.explanation: April 8, 2026 (60th MPC): FY27 GDP 6.9% (Q1 6.8, Q2 6.7, Q3 7.0, Q4 7.2) and CPI 4.6%. Repo held at 5.25% by a unanimous vote (RBI resolution).

questions.q: Which of the following did RBI project for the first time in its April 2026 Monetary Policy Statement, placing it at 4.4% for 2026-27?
options: Core inflation (CPI excluding food and fuel)
Current account deficit as % of GDP
questions.explanation: April 2026: RBI gave its first-ever core inflation projection, 4.4% for FY27 (Livemint). It was revised to 4.7% in June and 4.3% in August 2026.

questions.q: At the February 2026 MPC meeting the repo rate was held unanimously. Which member dissented on the stance by voting for a shift from 'neutral' to 'accommodative'?
questions.explanation: Feb 6, 2026 resolution: the neutral stance was retained, but Prof. Ram Singh kept his view that it should change to accommodative, as he had in Dec 2025.

questions.q: In the February 2026 policy, RBI gave only Q1 and Q2 projections for 2026-27 and deferred the full-year projections to April 2026. The reason was:
options: Awaiting IMD's first long-range monsoon forecast
Expiry of the terms of the external MPC members
Pending passage of the Union Budget 2026-27 in Parliament
Pending release of the new GDP and CPI series by MoSPI
questions.explanation: Feb 2026 resolution: full-year FY27 projections were to come in April, after incorporating the new CPI series (released Feb 12) and the new GDP series (Feb 27, 2026).

questions.q: The new Consumer Price Index series released by MoSPI on February 12, 2026, which now anchors RBI's inflation projections, has the base:
questions.explanation: Feb 12, 2026: the CPI series with base 2024=100 replaced the 2012 series. Its first reading was 2.75% inflation for January 2026 (Reuters; RBI April 2026 resolution).

questions.q: Along with cutting the repo rate to 5.25% on December 5, 2025, RBI announced open market operation (OMO) purchases of government securities worth:
questions.explanation: Dec 5, 2025 (58th MPC): a unanimous 25 bps cut to 5.25%, plus OMO purchases of ₹1 lakh crore (two ₹50,000 crore tranches) and a USD 5 billion 3-year USD/INR buy-sell swap (RBI press release).

questions.q: The December 2025 cut took the cumulative reduction in RBI's repo rate during calendar year 2025 (from 6.50%) to:
questions.explanation: 2025 cuts: Feb 25 bps, Apr 25, Jun 50, Dec 25, a total of 125 bps that took repo from 6.50% to 5.25%.

questions.q: What are the current Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) and Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) for scheduled commercial banks?
questions.explanation: The CRR was cut 100 bps to 3% in four 25 bps tranches between Sept 6 and Nov 29, 2025. The SLR is 18% of NDTL. Neither headline rate changed in any 2026 policy.

questions.q: Who among the following is NOT a member of RBI's Monetary Policy Committee as of September 2026?
questions.explanation: ED Indranil Bhattacharyya replaced Rajiv Ranjan as RBI's nominee from the Oct 2025 (57th) meeting. The Aug 2026 MPC: Malhotra, Poonam Gupta, I. Bhattacharyya, Nagesh Kumar, Saugata Bhattacharya, Ram Singh.

questions.q: On August 5, 2026, RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said polymer (plastic) banknotes could be introduced from FY28, subject to field trials. The trial covers which denominations?
questions.explanation: Aug 5, 2026 post-policy press conference: the Centre-approved (July 2026) trial covers polymer ₹10 and ₹20 notes, with rollout targeted from early FY28 (Business Standard, Business Today).

questions.q: In its August 2026 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies, RBI announced it would resume licensing, largely dormant since 2004, of new:
questions.explanation: Aug 5, 2026 SDRP: after a two-decade pause, RBI decided to resume 'on tap' licensing of Urban Co-operative Banks and released draft guidelines for comments the same day.

questions.q: Under amended directions announced in the February 2026 policy (effective April 1, 2026), the limit for collateral-free loans to Micro and Small Enterprises was raised from ₹10 lakh to:
questions.explanation: Feb 6, 2026 SDRP; MSME Lending Amendment Directions of Feb 9, 2026 raised the MSE collateral-free limit to ₹20 lakh for loans sanctioned or renewed from April 1, 2026.

questions.q: Under RBI's framework to compensate victims of small-value digital banking frauds (announced in the February 2026 policy, finalised in June 2026), the maximum compensation payable to a customer is:
questions.explanation: Compensation is 85% of the loss, capped at ₹25,000, for fraud losses up to ₹50,000. The final directions (June 24, 2026) take effect from Jan 1, 2027 (RBI).

questions.q: RBI's Central Board approved a record surplus transfer to the Central Government for the accounting year 2025-26 of approximately:
questions.explanation: May 22, 2026, 623rd Central Board meeting: ₹2,86,588.46 crore for FY26, about 6.7% more than the ₹2,68,590 crore transferred for FY25 (RBI).

questions.q: According to the RBI Annual Report 2025-26, the size of RBI's balance sheet as on March 31, 2026 was about:
questions.explanation: May 2026: RBI's balance sheet grew 20.61% to ₹91,97,121.08 crore (about ₹91.97 lakh crore) as on March 31, 2026, up from ₹76.25 lakh crore a year earlier (RBI).

questions.q: As per the RBI Annual Report 2025-26, the amount involved in frauds reported by banks during 2025-26 was:
questions.explanation: RBI Annual Report (May 29, 2026): the amount involved in FY26 frauds rose to ₹48,021 crore even as the number of cases fell, pushed up by legacy cases reported afresh.

questions.q: According to the RBI Annual Report 2025-26, counterfeit notes of which denomination were detected in the highest number in the banking system in 2025-26, rising by over 20% over the previous year?
questions.explanation: RBI Annual Report (May 2026): fake ₹500 notes rose over 20% in FY26 and made up about 61.8% of all counterfeit pieces detected.

questions.q: In November 2025, the RBI issued function-wise consolidated Master Directions for 11 types of regulated entities and repealed more than 9,400 circulars. How many Master Directions were issued in this exercise?
questions.explanation: On 28 Nov 2025 the RBI issued 244 consolidated Master Directions and repealed about 9,445 circulars. The October 2025 draft had proposed 238 (RBI / ET / Business Line).

questions.q: On 31 July 2026, the RBI repealed 628 circulars after consolidating their instructions into 64 Directions. Which RBI department administers these Directions?
options: Department of Payment and Settlement Systems
questions.explanation: On 31 Jul 2026 the RBI repealed 628 supervisory circulars and consolidated the instructions administered by the Department of Supervision (DoS) into 64 Directions (SCC Online, Aug 2026).

questions.q: The RBI (Commercial Banks – Asset Classification, Provisioning and Income Recognition) Directions, 2026, which bring in the Expected Credit Loss (ECL) framework, come into force from:
questions.explanation: The Directions were notified on 27 Apr 2026 and come into force on 1 Apr 2027. They apply to Commercial Banks, excluding SFBs, Payments Banks and Local Area Banks (RBI notification).

questions.q: Under the RBI's ECL framework for commercial banks, a loan more than how many days past due is presumed (unless rebutted) to show a 'significant increase in credit risk', moving it from Stage 1 to Stage 2?
questions.explanation: Under the ECL Directions of 27 Apr 2026, a significant increase in credit risk is presumed when contractual payments are more than 30 days past due. This presumption can be rebutted (RBI notification).

questions.q: To soften the one-time impact of moving to ECL provisioning, commercial banks may add back part of the transitional adjustment to CET1 capital over a glide path ending on:
questions.explanation: Under the ECL Directions of Apr 2026, the add-back falls from 4/5 in FY2027-28 to 1/5 in FY2030-31, so the glide path ends on 31 Mar 2031 (RBI notification).

questions.q: Under the RBI (Commercial Banks – Minimum Capital Requirements for Market Risk) Directions, 2026, issued on 21 September 2026, commercial banks must calculate market risk capital using the:
questions.explanation: The Basel III market risk Directions of 21 Sep 2026 take effect on 1 Apr 2027. Banks must use the Simplified Standardised Approach, and the Directions exclude SFBs, Payments Banks and LABs (RBI notification).

questions.q: Under the RBI (Commercial Banks – Credit Facilities) Amendment Directions, 2026 (13 February 2026), bank finance for an acquisition may not exceed what share of the acquisition value?
questions.explanation: Bank finance is capped at 75% of the acquisition value, and the post-deal debt-equity ratio must stay at or below 3:1. On 30 Mar 2026 the RBI deferred the norms to 1 Jul 2026 (RBI notifications).

questions.q: The RBI (Authentication Mechanisms for Digital Payment Transactions) Directions, 2025 require domestic digital payments to be verified with at least two distinct authentication factors. By what date did regulated entities have to comply for domestic transactions?
questions.explanation: The Directions were issued on 25 Sep 2025, and domestic 2FA compliance was due by 1 Apr 2026. A separate deadline of 1 Oct 2026 applies to non-recurring cross-border card-not-present transactions (MediaNama, Sep 2025).

questions.q: Under the RBI's revised capital market exposure norms of February 2026, the ceiling on bank loans to an individual against shares/eligible securities was raised from ₹20 lakh to:
questions.explanation: The Credit Facilities Amendment Directions of 13 Feb 2026 set a cap of ₹1 crore per individual and allowed IPO/FPO/ESOP financing of up to ₹25 lakh. They took effect on 1 Jul 2026 after being deferred (RBI notifications).

questions.q: Under the RBI's Lending Against Gold and Silver Collateral Directions, effective 1 April 2026, what is the maximum Loan-to-Value ratio for a gold loan of up to ₹2.5 lakh?
questions.explanation: The tiered LTV effective 1 Apr 2026 is 85% up to ₹2.5 lakh, 80% from ₹2.5 lakh to ₹5 lakh, and 75% above ₹5 lakh. It replaced the earlier flat 75% cap (RBI Directions of June 2025).

questions.q: Under the same Directions, which for the first time allow loans against silver, what is the aggregate limit on silver ornaments one borrower can pledge?
questions.explanation: From 1 Apr 2026 the limits are 10 kg for silver ornaments and 500 g for silver coins; silver bars and ETFs are not eligible. The gold limits are 1 kg for ornaments and 50 g for coins.

questions.q: If a lender does not return pledged gold/silver within 7 working days after the loan is fully repaid, RBI's gold and silver loan directions require it to compensate the borrower at:
questions.explanation: Under the gold and silver lending Directions effective 1 Apr 2026, a lender that delays returning the collateral beyond 7 working days pays ₹5,000 for each day of delay.

questions.q: Under the RBI's framework, finalised in June 2026, for compensating victims of small-value digital banking fraud, an eligible customer receives 85% of the net loss or ______, whichever is lower.
questions.explanation: The Directions of 24 Jun 2026 cover gross losses up to ₹50,000 and pay 85% of the net loss or ₹25,000, whichever is less, once in a lifetime. They apply to transactions on or after 1 Jan 2027 (RBI notification).

questions.q: In the RBI's digital-fraud compensation framework, for a domestic fraud the customer's bank and the beneficiary bank each contribute 10% of the net loss. What share does the RBI bear?
questions.explanation: Under the June 2026 Directions, the RBI bears 65% of a domestic fraud loss and each bank 10%. At the ₹25,000 cap that is ₹19,118 from the RBI and ₹2,941 from each bank. In cross-border cases the customer's bank bears 20%.

questions.q: The Reserve Bank – Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, effective 1 July 2026, raised the maximum compensation an Ombudsman can award for consequential loss to:
questions.explanation: RB-IOS 2026 replaced RB-IOS 2021 on 1 Jul 2026. It raised the consequential-loss cap from ₹20 lakh to ₹30 lakh and the harassment/mental-anguish cap from ₹1 lakh to ₹3 lakh (Rediff, Jul 2026).

questions.q: Under the Risk-Based Premium framework for deposit insurance, which DICGC implemented from 1 April 2026, the annual premium per ₹100 of assessable deposits ranges between:
questions.explanation: The framework was released on 6 Feb 2026 and replaced the flat 12 paise with 8–12 paise. Banks are rated in categories A to D, with a vintage discount of up to 25% (Rediff, Feb 2026).

questions.q: In June 2025, the RBI cut the overall priority sector lending target for Small Finance Banks from 75% of ANBC to:
questions.explanation: The revision of 20 Jun 2025 applies from FY2025-26. Of the new 60%, 40% follows the existing sub-targets, and the flexible part for sectors where the SFB has an advantage falls from 35% to 20% (BusinessLine, Jun 2025).

questions.q: Under the RBI's January 2026 PSL amendment, bank loans to which institution for on-lending now qualify as priority sector credit?
questions.explanation: The PSL Amendment Directions, effective 19 Jan 2026, allow bank loans to NCDC for on-lending to count as priority sector lending (TOI, Jan 2026).

questions.q: Under the RBI's Lending to MSME Sector (Amendment) Directions, 2026, banks are mandated not to accept collateral for loans to Micro and Small Enterprises of up to:
questions.explanation: The amendment of 9 Feb 2026, effective 1 Apr 2026, raised the mandatory collateral-free limit from ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh. Banks may go up to ₹25 lakh for units with a good track record (RBI notification).

questions.q: From 1 July 2026, an NBFC that neither uses public funds nor has a customer interface does not need RBI registration if its asset size is below:
questions.explanation: From 1 Jul 2026, such NBFCs with assets below ₹1,000 crore are exempt from registration as 'Unregistered Type I NBFCs'. Existing eligible NBFCs could apply for deregistration by 31 Dec 2026 (Business Today, Aug 2026).

questions.q: Under the RBI (Commercial Banks – Cybersecurity, Technology: Risk, Resilience and Assurance Framework) Directions, 2026, issued on 31 July 2026, within how many hours must a bank report a cyber security incident to the RBI?
questions.explanation: The Directions of 31 Jul 2026 took effect immediately for commercial banks. Cyber incidents must be reported on the RBI's DAKSH platform within six hours (MediaNama, Aug 2026).

questions.q: The RBI (Commercial Banks – Governance) Amendment Directions of 14 July 2026, effective 1 October 2026, introduced a principle-based framework for which of the following?
options: Compensation of whole-time directors and CEOs
Matters to be placed before the Board of banks
questions.explanation: The 14 Jul 2026 amendment sets out which matters must go before the Board and which can be delegated. It applies to PSBs and, with suitable changes, to private sector banks from 1 Oct 2026 (RBI notification).

questions.q: In September 2025, the RBI set up a six-member Advisory Group on Regulation (AGR) alongside its Regulatory Review Cell, which will review every regulation every 5–7 years. Who chairs the AGR?
questions.explanation: The AGR was formed on 17 Sep 2025 and is headed by SBI MD Rana Ashutosh Kumar Singh. Shyam Srinivasan is a member, and Pushpak Bhattacharyya chaired the FREE-AI committee.

questions.q: In March 2026, the RBI imposed a penalty of ₹95.40 lakh on which public sector bank, partly for failing to shadow-reverse (credit) amounts involved in unauthorised electronic transactions within 10 working days?
questions.explanation: RBI press releases of 27 Mar 2026: Union Bank of India ₹95.40 lakh, Central Bank of India ₹63.60 lakh (CKYCR and BSBD lapses) and Bank of India ₹58.50 lakh (PSL charges and deposit interest).

questions.q: In March 2026, the RBI fined Pine Labs ₹3.10 lakh for issuing full-KYC instruments without completing customer KYC. Which set of RBI directions did it breach?
questions.explanation: The RBI press release of 27 Mar 2026 cites non-compliance with the directions on Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPIs), found in an inspection covering Jul 2024 to May 2025.

questions.q: In September 2026, with the rupee under pressure, the RBI amended the FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations. From 1 October 2026, within how many months must exporters realise and repatriate the proceeds of normal (non-INR-invoiced) exports?
questions.explanation: The September 2026 amendment replaced 15 months with 9 months, and 18 with 12 months for INR-invoiced exports. It takes effect on 1 Oct 2026 (TaxGuru / BusinessLine, Sep 2026).

questions.q: In June 2026, to attract foreign currency inflows, the RBI opened a special USD-INR swap window for fresh FCNR(B) deposits and exempted them from CRR and SLR. Deposits of which tenor were covered?
questions.explanation: The window for fresh 3–5 year FCNR(B) deposits was originally open until 30 Sep 2026. The RBI closed it early, on 31 Aug 2026, after strong inflows (BusinessLine / Indian Express).

questions.q: From 1 April 2026, under the Union Budget 2026-27, TCS on LRS remittances above ₹10 lakh for education and medical treatment was cut from 5% to:
questions.explanation: Budget 2026-27 (1 Feb 2026) cut TCS on education and medical remittances under LRS to 2% and also cut TCS on overseas tour packages to 2% (Moneycontrol, Feb 2026).

questions.q: Under the RBI (Project Finance) Directions, 2025, effective 1 October 2025, what is the standard asset provision for a Commercial Real Estate (CRE) project during construction?
questions.explanation: During construction, the provision is 1.25% for CRE and 1% for other projects, including CRE-RH. In the operational phase it falls to 1% (CRE), 0.75% (CRE-RH) and 0.40% (others).

questions.q: Under the RBI's June 2025 KYC amendment, low-risk individual customers whose periodic KYC update is due may keep transacting and update their KYC within one year of the due date or up to ______, whichever is later.
questions.explanation: The June 2025 KYC amendment set the relaxation up to 30 Jun 2026. It requires at least 3 advance intimations and 3 reminders, each including at least one letter, and had to be implemented before 1 Jan 2026.

questions.q: In May 2026, who took charge as Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India for a three-year term, succeeding T. Rabi Sankar?
questions.explanation: Rohit Jain, earlier an RBI Executive Director in charge of supervision, took charge on 4 May 2026 for three years after T. Rabi Sankar's term ended (RBI press release, 4 May 2026).

questions.q: In June 2026, the Centre re-appointed Swaminathan J as Deputy Governor of the RBI. For how long was he re-appointed?
questions.explanation: He was re-appointed for two years from 26 June 2026 (RBI release, 5 June 2026). The former SBI MD is the senior-most DG and handles coordination.

questions.q: After the RBI reshuffled its Deputy Governors' portfolios in May 2026, which DG was given the Department of Currency Management and the Department of Payment and Settlement Systems?
questions.explanation: In the reshuffle effective 4 May 2026, S.C. Murmu got currency management, payment systems, regulation, communication and enforcement. Rohit Jain got fintech, IT, forex and financial markets regulation (RBI, 4 May 2026).

questions.q: Ravi Shankar became an Executive Director of the RBI from 1 July 2026. Which department will he look after?
options: Department of Statistics and Information Management
questions.explanation: Ravi Shankar was Adviser-in-Charge of DSIM and became ED from 1 July 2026 with charge of the same department (RBI press release, 1 July 2026).

questions.q: Brajesh Kumar Singh, earlier Executive Director of Indian Bank, took charge on 1 June 2026 as MD & CEO of which public sector bank?
questions.explanation: He took charge at Bengaluru-headquartered Canara Bank on 1 June 2026, with a tenure until 30 April 2029. K. Satyanarayana Raju had retired on 31 Dec 2025, and ED Hardeep Singh Ahluwalia held additional charge in between.

questions.q: Vinay Muralidhar Tonse took charge as MD & CEO of Yes Bank on 6 April 2026. Which bank did he previously serve as Managing Director?
questions.explanation: Tonse was SBI MD (Retail Business & Operations) until 30 Nov 2025. RBI approved a 3-year term on 3 Feb 2026, and he succeeded Prashant Kumar on 6 Apr 2026 (Yes Bank filings).

questions.q: Which foreign bank became the largest shareholder of Yes Bank in September 2025 after acquiring a 20% stake, including about 13.18% bought from SBI?
questions.explanation: Japan's SMBC completed its 20% acquisition on 18 Sept 2025, buying from SBI and other banks. The SBI portion was about 13.18%, for roughly Rs 8,889 crore. SMBC later raised its holding further.

questions.q: In July 2026, the RBI approved former Chief Election Commissioner Rajiv Kumar as part-time chairman of which bank?
questions.explanation: RBI approved a three-year term from 15 July 2026. He succeeds Atanu Chakraborty, who resigned on 18 March 2026; Keki Mistry was interim chairman in between (HDFC Bank filing, 15 July 2026).

questions.q: For which period did the RBI approve Sandeep Bakhshi's re-appointment as MD & CEO of ICICI Bank?
questions.explanation: An RBI letter dated 22 May 2026 approved a two-year term from 4 Oct 2026 to 3 Oct 2028 (ICICI Bank filing, 22 May 2026). Bakhshi has led ICICI Bank since 2018.

questions.q: Arijit Basu, a former Managing Director of SBI, was appointed part-time chairman of which private sector bank for three years from 31 January 2026?
questions.explanation: Basu succeeded Sunil Mehta as IndusInd Bank's part-time chairman for a term from 31 Jan 2026 to 30 Jan 2029. He was earlier chairman of HDB Financial Services (IndusInd filing, 31 Jan 2026).

questions.q: In February 2026, the Gujarat government appointed Uday Kotak as chairman of GIFT City. Whom did he succeed?
questions.explanation: Kotak succeeded former Finance Secretary Hasmukh Adhia, who chaired GIFT City from June 2022 until 15 Feb 2026. Kotak is chairman as a nominee of the Gujarat government.

questions.q: RBI has approved Mahesh Muralidhar Pai as MD & CEO of South Indian Bank from 1 October 2026. Where is the bank headquartered?
questions.explanation: An RBI letter dated 7 July 2026 approved a three-year term from 1 Oct 2026. Pai was a CGM for digital banking at Canara Bank. South Indian Bank is headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala.

questions.q: R. Vijay Anandh took over as MD & CEO on 1 May 2026, succeeding N. Kamakodi. Which bank does he head?
questions.explanation: An RBI letter dated 9 Feb 2026 approved Vijay Anandh, then an Executive Director, for a 3-year term from 1 May 2026. City Union Bank is headquartered in Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu.

questions.q: Sanjeev Nautiyal stepped down as MD & CEO of Ujjivan Small Finance Bank on 1 September 2026. Who was given interim charge?
questions.explanation: Nautiyal sought early retirement on health grounds. RBI approved Executive Director Carol Furtado as interim CEO for three months from 1 Sept 2026 (Ujjivan SFB filings, Sept 2026).

questions.q: Rajan Bajaj was appointed MD & CEO of slice Small Finance Bank in February 2026. slice SFB was formed by the merger of the fintech slice with which bank?
questions.explanation: The slice-NESFB merger was India's first fintech-bank merger. It was completed in Oct 2024, and the bank was renamed slice Small Finance Bank in May 2025. Bajaj, slice's founder, became MD & CEO in Feb 2026.

questions.q: In April 2026, the Centre extended Debadatta Chand's tenure as MD & CEO by three years beyond 30 June 2026. Which bank does he head?
questions.explanation: A Central Government notification dated 23 April 2026 extended Chand's tenure at Bank of Baroda by three years beyond his term ending 30 June 2026 (BoB filing, 23 April 2026).

questions.q: Ashwani Kumar completed his tenure as MD & CEO of UCO Bank on 31 May 2026. Who was then given additional charge of the post?
questions.explanation: By a DFS letter dated 19 June 2026, UCO Bank ED Rajendra Kumar Saboo got additional charge of MD & CEO until 31 Aug 2026 or until a regular appointment (UCO Bank filing, 19 June 2026).

questions.q: The Centre's strategic disinvestment of IDBI Bank covers what combined stake held by the Government of India and LIC?
questions.explanation: The Government of India is selling 30.48% and LIC 30.24%, a total of 60.72%. The sale was still in progress in Sept 2026 (IDBI Bank disclosures).

questions.q: In June 2026, Emirates NBD completed the acquisition of what stake in RBL Bank through a preferential issue?
questions.explanation: On 18 June 2026, RBL Bank allotted 92.91 crore shares at Rs 280 each (about Rs 26,016 crore), giving ENBD 60%. No shares were tendered in its 26% open offer, so ENBD holds 60% and is now the promoter.

questions.q: In February 2026, the RBI approved global private equity firm Blackstone to acquire up to 9.99% stake in which bank?
questions.explanation: Federal Bank disclosed on 5 Feb 2026 that RBI had approved Blackstone affiliate Asia II Topco XIII. The affiliate is investing about Rs 6,196.5 crore in the Aluva-based bank through a preferential issue of warrants.

questions.q: In August-September 2026, the RBI allowed LIC to raise its aggregate holding to up to 9.99% in which two private banks?
options: Axis Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank
questions.explanation: HDFC Bank disclosed the RBI approval (letter dated 19 Aug 2026) for LIC. ICICI Bank received its copy of the approval on 4 Sept 2026, valid for one year.

questions.q: Which committee did the Union Budget 2026-27 announce to comprehensively review the banking sector?
options: High Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat
questions.explanation: The 1 Feb 2026 Budget speech proposed a High Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat. Its job is to review the sector and align it with India's next phase of growth while safeguarding stability, inclusion and consumer protection.

questions.q: Which was the first payments bank to receive RBI's in-principle approval to convert into a small finance bank?
questions.explanation: RBI granted Fino Payments Bank in-principle approval on 5 Dec 2025 under on-tap SFB licensing. Resident-controlled payments banks become eligible after 5 years of operations.

questions.q: Which publication named State Bank of India the 'World's Best Consumer Bank 2026'?
questions.explanation: Global Finance announced the award on 16 July 2026. It will be presented on 17 Oct 2026 in Bangkok during the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings. SBI serves over 520 million customers.

questions.q: Which bank was named 'India's Best Bank' in the Euromoney Awards for Excellence 2026?
questions.explanation: Euromoney (17 July 2026) cited HDFC Bank's leadership in retail, MSME and corporate banking in 2025, with 100 million customers and 9,616 branches.

questions.q: Which institution was named India's best private bank in the Euromoney Private Banking Awards 2026?
questions.explanation: Kotak Private Banking, a division of Kotak Mahindra Bank, won for its financial strength, digital innovation and talent development (Euromoney, 20 March 2026).

questions.q: In April 2026, Bank of Baroda unveiled 'bob SAMVAD', an AI-powered multilingual conversational platform for its branches. How many languages does it support?
questions.explanation: The platform was built in-house and launched in Mumbai by DFS Secretary M. Nagaraju (announced 8 April 2026). It supports real-time two-way communication in 22 languages, starting in 250 branches across 5 states.

questions.q: Union Cooperation Minister Amit Shah launched 'Bank in a Box' in August 2026, along with a Security Operations Centre. Which institutions is this technology platform for?
questions.explanation: It was launched on 8 Aug 2026 in Mumbai at NUCFDC's 'Sahakar Nav-Kranti' event. It gives urban cooperative banks core banking, digital payments and cloud compliance, and the SOC adds 24/7 cyber surveillance.

questions.q: Which of the following institution-head pairs is INCORRECTLY matched as of September 2026?
options: State Bank of India - Challa Sreenivasulu Setty
questions.explanation: IRDAI has been headed by former Finance Secretary Ajay Seth since 2025, after Debasish Panda's term ended in March 2025. The other three pairs are correct.

questions.q: As per the Union Budget 2026-27 presented on 1 February 2026, the Centre's fiscal deficit for FY 2026-27 has been targeted at what percentage of GDP?
questions.explanation: Budget speech (1 Feb 2026): fiscal deficit in BE 2026-27 is estimated at 4.3% of GDP, down from 4.4% in RE 2025-26.

questions.q: What is the public capital expenditure outlay announced for FY 2026-27 in the Union Budget 2026-27?
questions.explanation: Budget speech (1 Feb 2026): public capex raised to Rs 12.2 lakh crore for FY27, up from Rs 11.2 lakh crore in BE 2025-26 (about Rs 11 lakh crore in RE 2025-26).

questions.q: Under the debt-based fiscal anchor in Budget 2026-27, the Centre aims to bring its debt-to-GDP ratio down to what level by 2030-31?
questions.explanation: Budget speech (1 Feb 2026) reaffirms the target of 50 ± 1% of GDP by 2030-31 (first set in Budget 2025-26); debt is estimated at 55.6% of GDP in BE 2026-27.

questions.q: What nominal GDP growth rate for 2026-27 did the Union Budget 2026-27 assume in its estimates?
questions.explanation: The Budget 2026-27 (Feb 2026) estimates assume 10% nominal GDP growth for FY27, according to the PRS Budget Analysis.

questions.q: The Union Budget 2026-27, presented on 1 February 2026, was Nirmala Sitharaman's ____ consecutive Budget and the first prepared at ____.
questions.explanation: On 1 Feb 2026 Sitharaman presented her 9th consecutive Budget (counting the 2024 interim Budget). Her speech calls it 'the first Budget prepared in Kartavya Bhawan'.

questions.q: The Union Budget 2026-27 was built around three 'Kartavyas' (duties). Which of the following is NOT one of them?
options: Ensure every family, community, region and sector has access to resources and opportunities
Fulfil the aspirations of people and build their capacity
Achieve a fiscal deficit of 3% of GDP by 2030-31
questions.explanation: Budget speech (1 Feb 2026): the three kartavyas are growth, people's aspirations and capacity, and access for all (Sabka Sath, Sabka Vikas). None of them is a fiscal-deficit target.

questions.q: In Budget 2026-27 the Government accepted the 16th Finance Commission's recommendation on vertical devolution. What share of the divisible pool goes to States, and who chairs the Commission?
questions.explanation: The 16th FC, chaired by Arvind Panagariya, submitted its report on 17 Nov 2025 (tabled 1 Feb 2026). It retains the States' share at 41% for 2026-31, as under the 15th FC.

questions.q: Which new criterion, carrying a 10% weight, has the 16th Finance Commission added to its horizontal devolution formula for 2026-31?
