questions.explanation: PRS summary of the 16th FC report (Feb 2026): 'Contribution to GDP' (10%) replaces tax and fiscal efforts. Income distance, at 42.5%, has the largest weight.

questions.q: The Income-tax Act, 2025, which Budget 2026-27 confirmed would come into force on 1 April 2026, replaces which law?
questions.explanation: Budget speech (1 Feb 2026): the review of the Income Tax Act, 1961 is complete, and the Income Tax Act, 2025 comes into effect from 1 April 2026.

questions.q: Budget 2026-27 raised the Securities Transaction Tax (STT) on the sale of futures from 0.02% to what rate?
questions.explanation: Budget 2026-27 (Feb 2026) raised STT on futures from 0.02% to 0.05%. STT on options premium (0.1%) and on exercise of options (0.125%) both rose to 0.15%.

questions.q: Budget 2026-27 cut the TCS on remittances under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) for education and medical treatment from 5% to what rate?
questions.explanation: Finance Bill 2026 (Feb 2026) cuts TCS on LRS remittances for education and medical treatment from 5% to 2%, and TCS on overseas tour packages to 2%.

questions.q: Budget 2026-27 extended the tax holiday for eligible units in the International Financial Services Centre (GIFT City) and Offshore Banking Units from 10 years to how many years?
questions.explanation: Finance Bill 2026 (Feb 2026) extends the deduction to 20 consecutive years out of 25 for IFSC units and to 20 consecutive years for OBUs, with a 15% tax rate after that.

questions.q: 'FAST-DS 2026', a one-time scheme announced in Budget 2026-27 for small taxpayers, deals with the disclosure of:
options: Undisclosed foreign assets and foreign income
questions.explanation: The Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers - Disclosure Scheme, 2026 (Budget, Feb 2026) is a one-time 6-month window for declaring foreign assets and foreign-sourced income below set thresholds, with immunity from prosecution.

questions.q: Budget 2026-27 cut the customs tariff on all dutiable goods imported for personal use from 20% to what rate?
questions.explanation: Budget speech (1 Feb 2026): the tariff rate on all dutiable goods imported for personal use falls from 20% to 10%.

questions.q: Budget 2026-27 fully exempted how many drugs and medicines for cancer patients from Basic Customs Duty?
questions.explanation: Budget 2026-27 (Feb 2026) exempted 17 drugs from BCD and added 7 more rare diseases to the personal-import exemption list. The 36 life-saving drugs were exempted in Budget 2025-26.

questions.q: Under the GST rate rationalisation ('GST 2.0') that took effect on 22 September 2025, what are the two main GST slabs?
questions.explanation: The 56th GST Council meeting (3 Sep 2025) moved to two main slabs of 5% and 18%, with a 40% special rate on luxury and sin goods, effective 22 Sep 2025.

questions.q: What outlay did Budget 2026-27 announce for 'Biopharma SHAKTI', meant to make India a global hub for biologics and biosimilars?
questions.explanation: Biopharma SHAKTI (Budget, Feb 2026) has Rs 10,000 crore over 5 years. It includes 3 new NIPERs, upgrades to 7 existing ones, and over 1,000 accredited clinical trial sites.

questions.q: Budget 2026-27 raised the outlay of the Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme from Rs 22,919 crore to what amount?
questions.explanation: Budget speech (Feb 2026): the ECMS, launched in April 2025, already had investment commitments at double its target, so its outlay was raised to Rs 40,000 crore.

questions.q: Budget 2026-27 proposed dedicated Rare Earth Corridors for mining, processing, research and manufacturing. Which of the following states is NOT among them?
questions.explanation: Budget speech (Feb 2026): the Rare Earth Corridors are in Odisha, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.

questions.q: Budget 2026-27 announced a dedicated Rs 10,000 crore fund to give equity support to high-potential 'Champion' MSMEs. What is it called?
options: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises
questions.explanation: Budget 2026-27 (Feb 2026) created a Rs 10,000 crore SME Growth Fund. The Self-Reliant India Fund received only a Rs 2,000 crore top-up.

questions.q: Budget 2026-27 announced seven high-speed rail corridors. Which of the following is NOT one of them?
questions.explanation: Budget speech (Feb 2026): the seven corridors are Mumbai-Pune, Pune-Hyderabad, Hyderabad-Bengaluru, Hyderabad-Chennai, Chennai-Bengaluru, Delhi-Varanasi and Varanasi-Siliguri.

questions.q: As part of financial sector reforms, Budget 2026-27 proposed restructuring which two public sector NBFCs to improve their scale and efficiency?
options: Power Finance Corporation and REC Ltd
questions.explanation: Budget 2026-27 (Feb 2026) proposed restructuring PFC and REC as a first step for PSU NBFCs, and also a High Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat.

questions.q: 'Bharat-VISTAAR', announced in Budget 2026-27 as a multilingual AI tool for farmers, stands for:
options: Value-chain Integrated System for Trade in Agricultural Resources
Village Information System for Technology and Agricultural Advisory Resources
Virtually Integrated System to Access Agricultural Resources
Virtual Interface for Soil Testing and Agri Research
questions.explanation: Bharat-VISTAAR (Budget, Feb 2026) uses AI with the AgriStack portals and ICAR's package of practices to give farmers customised advice.

questions.q: Which new Dedicated Freight Corridor did the Union Budget 2026-27 announce?
questions.explanation: Budget 2026-27 (Feb 2026) announced a new DFC from Dankuni in the east to Surat in the west. Ludhiana-Dankuni (EDFC) and Dadri-JNPT (WDFC) already exist.

questions.q: The Economic Survey 2025-26, tabled in January 2026, projected India's real GDP growth for FY 2026-27 in which range?
questions.explanation: Economic Survey 2025-26 (Jan 2026), Chapter 1: FY27 real GDP growth is projected at 6.8-7.2%, and FY26 growth is estimated at 7.4%.

questions.q: Borrowing Mariana Mazzucato's phrase, the Preface to the Economic Survey 2025-26 argues that India's state machinery needs to become a/an:
questions.explanation: Survey Preface (Jan 2026): an 'entrepreneurial state' is one that acts before certainty emerges, structures risk rather than avoiding it, and learns from experimentation.

questions.q: The Economic Survey 2025-26 charts a path from import substitution to 'strategic resilience' and then 'strategic indispensability'. It describes Swadeshi as a ____ strategy rather than a blanket doctrine.
questions.explanation: Economic Survey 2025-26 (Jan 2026), Ch 16 Part I: 'Swadeshi is a disciplined strategy rather than a blanket doctrine.' It is backed by a three-tier framework for strategic indigenisation.

questions.q: On 27 February 2026, MoSPI released a new series of national accounts (GDP) estimates. What is the base year of this new series?
questions.explanation: Economic Survey 2025-26 (Jan 2026): national accounts are being rebased to 2022-23 (from 2011-12), with the new series due on 27 Feb 2026.

questions.q: As per the NSO estimates released on 31 August 2026, India's real GDP grew by how much in the April–June quarter (Q1) of FY 2026-27?
questions.explanation: NSO (31 Aug 2026): real GDP grew 7.8% in Q1 FY27, the same pace as Q4 FY26. The RBI Bulletin (Sept 2026) also cites 7.8%.

questions.q: According to the Provisional Estimates released by NSO in June 2026 under the new GDP series (base 2022-23), India's real GDP growth for FY 2025-26 was:
questions.explanation: NSO Provisional Estimates (June 2026): FY26 real GDP growth was 7.7%, up from the 7.6% Second Advance Estimate (Feb 2026). The World Bank's June 2026 GEP also uses 7.7%.

questions.q: MoSPI released a new series of GDP estimates on 27 February 2026. What is the base year of this new series?
questions.explanation: MoSPI (27 Feb 2026): the new National Accounts series uses base year 2022-23, replacing 2011-12. The IIP and WPI also moved to a 2022-23 base in June 2026.

questions.q: Under the new Consumer Price Index (CPI) series released by MoSPI in 2026 (first print on 12 February 2026), which year is the base year?
questions.explanation: The new CPI (base 2024=100, 358 items, weights from HCES 2023-24) replaced the 2012 series. Its first print (12 Feb 2026) put January 2026 inflation at 2.75%.

questions.q: In its August 2026 monetary policy, the RBI MPC kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% and revised India's real GDP growth projection for FY 2026-27 to:
questions.explanation: RBI MPC (5 Aug 2026): the FY27 GDP projection was raised to 6.7% (6.6% in June, 6.9% in April) and the CPI projection was cut to 5.0% from 5.1%.

questions.q: In March 2026, the Government notified the CPI inflation target for RBI at 4% with a tolerance band of +/-2% for which period?
questions.explanation: RBI Annual Report 2025-26: a Gazette notification of 25 Mar 2026 retained the 4% (2–6%) target for 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2031.

questions.q: In its July 2026 World Economic Outlook Update, the IMF projected India's growth for FY 2026-27 at:
questions.explanation: IMF WEO Update (July 2026): India's FY27 growth was put at 6.4% (6.5% in the April 2026 WEO), and FY28 was raised to 6.7% (source: DEA Monthly Economic Review).

questions.q: The World Bank's Global Economic Prospects report of June 2026 projected India's GDP growth for FY 2026-27 at:
questions.explanation: World Bank GEP (June 2026): India's FY27 growth was put at 6.6% (up 0.1 pp from January) and FY26 was estimated at 7.7%, as the Middle East conflict slowed global growth to 2.5%.

questions.q: The Economic Survey 2025-26, tabled in Parliament in January 2026, projected India's real GDP growth for FY 2026-27 in the range of:
questions.explanation: Economic Survey 2025-26 (Chapter 1): 'the Economic Survey projects real GDP growth in FY27 in the range of 6.8 to 7.2 per cent.'

questions.q: As per MoSPI data released in September 2026, India's CPI-based retail inflation for August 2026 stood at:
questions.explanation: MoSPI (14 Sept 2026): August 2026 CPI inflation was 4.82%, up from 4.45% in July. Food & beverages inflation was 5.95%.

questions.q: India's WPI-based wholesale inflation (base 2022-23) for August 2026 was:
questions.explanation: WPI (Sept 2026): wholesale inflation rose to 9.92% in August 2026 from 9.78% in July, led by fuel (about 22.9%) and food.

questions.q: India's foreign exchange reserves hit an all-time high in the week ended 4 September 2026 after a weekly jump of about $44.9 billion. What was the level of reserves?
questions.explanation: RBI Weekly Statistical Supplement (11 Sept 2026): reserves rose $44.9 bn in the week to an all-time high of $785.71 bn as of 4 Sept 2026.

questions.q: On the back of its record forex reserves in September 2026, India overtook which country to become the world's fourth-largest holder of foreign exchange reserves?
questions.explanation: India was 5th at end-March 2026. At $785.7 bn (4 Sept 2026) it passed Russia (about $761 bn) to rank 4th, after China, Japan and Switzerland.

questions.q: India's gross GST collection hit an all-time monthly high in April 2026. What was the amount?
questions.explanation: GSTN/DEA (May 2026): April 2026 GST collection (CGST+SGST+IGST) was a record ₹2.43 lakh crore, up 8.7% year on year.

questions.q: As per Commerce Ministry data, India's total exports (goods + services) reached a record high in FY 2025-26 of about:
questions.explanation: Commerce Ministry (15 Apr 2026): FY26 total exports were a record of about US$860.09 bn, up 4.2% from $825.26 bn in FY25. Goods exports were $441.8 bn.

questions.q: The Union Budget 2026-27 set the fiscal deficit target for FY 2026-27 at what percentage of GDP?
questions.explanation: Union Budget 2026-27 (1 Feb 2026): fiscal deficit target of 4.3% of GDP and debt-to-GDP of 55.6%, assuming 10% nominal GDP growth.

questions.q: In May 2026, the RBI Central Board approved a record surplus transfer (dividend) to the Central Government for the accounting year 2025-26. What was the amount?
questions.explanation: RBI Central Board, 623rd meeting (22 May 2026): surplus transfer of ₹2,86,588.46 crore (about ₹2.87 lakh crore) for FY26, against ₹2.69 lakh crore for FY25.

questions.q: In September 2026, which credit rating agency upgraded India's sovereign rating to 'A-' from 'BBB+'?
questions.explanation: JCR (2 Sept 2026) upgraded India's sovereign rating to A- from BBB+ with a stable outlook.

questions.q: As per the IMF's April 2026 World Economic Outlook data, India is the sixth-largest economy in nominal US dollar terms. Which two countries rank immediately above India (4th and 5th)?
questions.explanation: IMF WEO (Apr 2026) 2026 ranking: USA, China, Germany, Japan (4th), UK (5th), India (6th, about $4.15 tn). The causes were a weaker rupee and a lower nominal GDP under the new series.

questions.q: India achieved its best-ever rank in the SDG Index of the Sustainable Development Report 2026, published by the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN). What was the rank?
questions.explanation: SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2026: India ranked 94th (score 68.33), up from 99th in 2025. Finland topped the index.

questions.q: In the World Happiness Report 2026 (released March 2026), India was ranked ______, while ______ was named the happiest country for the ninth consecutive time.
questions.explanation: World Happiness Report 2026 (March 2026): India ranked 116th, and Finland was the happiest country for the 9th year in a row.

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs of India's ranks in global indices:
1. Corruption Perceptions Index 2025 (Transparency International) – 91st
2. World Press Freedom Index 2026 (Reporters Without Borders) – 157th
3. Global Peace Index 2026 (Institute for Economics & Peace) – 115th
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
questions.explanation: CPI 2025: India 91st of 182 (score 39). RSF 2026: 157th of 180. GPI 2026: India 127th, so pair 3 is wrong.

questions.q: At the Global Fintech Fest (GFF) 2026, the RBI Governor launched 'UPI Tap & Pay' on NFC-enabled POS terminals. Up to what amount can users make UPI PIN-less transactions using this feature?
questions.explanation: GFF 2026 (Sep 2026): RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra launched Tap & Pay. It is PIN-less up to ₹5,000, and above that the UPI PIN is entered on the POS terminal.

questions.q: 'MyUPI' (UPI Help 2.0), an AI-powered customer support platform launched at GFF 2026, is built on which Small Language Model developed by NPCI?
questions.explanation: NPCI, Sep 2026: MyUPI is built on NPCI's Small Language Model FiMI. It gives a single view of UPI transactions and AutoPay mandates across banks and apps.

questions.q: Which feature of NPCI's MyUPI platform (launched Sept 2026) lets a user request that UPI debit transactions be declined if the user suspects the account is compromised?
questions.explanation: NPCI, Sep 2026: 'Safety Switch' blocks UPI debits when a compromise is suspected. UPI Number Delink stops receipts on a mobile number, and Transaction Replay repeats past payments.

questions.q: In 2026, NPCI raised the per-transaction limit for UPI payments authorised through on-device biometrics (fingerprint or face authentication) from ₹5,000 to:
questions.explanation: Biometric UPI was capped at ₹5,000 until early 2026 (PhonePe, Feb 2026). By Sep 2026, Scapia and Samsung Wallet allowed up to ₹10,000 'in line with NPCI guidelines'.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a subsidiary of the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)?
questions.explanation: NPCI's subsidiaries are NIPL, NBBL, NBSL and NTSL (NPCI Tech Solutions, its fourth). There is no 'NPCI Credit Services Ltd'.

questions.q: Who was the Non-Executive Chairman and Independent Director of NPCI at the time of the GFF 2026 UPI launches?
questions.explanation: NPCI release, Sep 2026: the launches took place in the presence of Ajay Kumar Choudhary, Non-Executive Chairman and Independent Director of NPCI. Dilip Asbe is MD & CEO.

questions.q: In June 2026, UPI went live in Greece, and Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal witnessed a live demonstration at the partner bank's headquarters in Athens. The service was enabled through a partnership between NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL) and which Greek bank?
questions.explanation: 30 Jun 2026: Goyal posted about the Eurobank–NIPL partnership demonstration at Eurobank HQ in Athens. France and Greece are now the European countries that accept UPI.

questions.q: On 30 August 2026, during PM Modi's visit to Uzbekistan, NIPL signed an agreement with the National Interbank Processing Centre (NIPC) so that Indian travellers can pay by scanning the UZQR code. NIPC operates which national payment system of Uzbekistan?
questions.explanation: Finance Ministry, 31 Aug 2026: NIPL signed with NIPC, operator of HUMO, on 30 Aug. The Central Bank of Uzbekistan designated HUMO as NIPL's authorised partner, and UPI apps will scan UZQR.

questions.q: 'Favara', an instant payment system that was linked with India's UPI on 30 July 2026 for person-to-person remittances into Indian bank accounts, belongs to which country?
questions.explanation: July 2026: the Maldives Monetary Authority and NIPL made the Favara–UPI corridor live. P2P transfers started with Bank of Maldives and Maldives Islamic Bank.

questions.q: In June 2026, UPI acceptance went live in Cambodia through NIPL's partnership with ACLEDA Bank Plc. Indian travellers can pay at merchants there by scanning which national QR code?
questions.explanation: RBI/NPCI, 2 Jun 2026: Indian UPI apps can scan Bakong's KHQR codes at more than 4.5 million merchant outlets in Cambodia. The NIPL–ACLEDA pact was signed in Dec 2025.

questions.q: In February 2026, NIPL signed an agreement with PayNet to link UPI with the DuitNow QR network for cross-border QR payments. PayNet is the national payments network of which country?
questions.explanation: 12 Feb 2026: NIPL signed with Payments Network Malaysia (PayNet) to link UPI with DuitNow QR. In phase 1, Indian tourists can pay at more than 29 lakh DuitNow QR points.

questions.q: According to the RBI's Payment Systems Report released in May 2026, what share of India's total payment transaction volume did UPI account for in the second half (H2) of 2025?
questions.explanation: RBI Payment Systems Report, May 2026: UPI had an 85.5% share of volume in H2 2025 but only 9.5% of value. RTGS led by value with 68.6%.

questions.q: The Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC), set up as a Section 8 not-for-profit company, is an initiative of which department?
options: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
questions.explanation: ONDC was incorporated in December 2021 as a Section 8 company under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, to democratise e-commerce through open protocols.

questions.q: As per NPCI data, UPI recorded its highest-ever monthly transaction volume in August 2026. What was that volume?
questions.explanation: NPCI data (1 Sep 2026): August 2026 saw a record 24.51 billion transactions worth ₹29.82 lakh crore, up from about 23.7 billion in July 2026.

questions.q: UPI completed 10 years of operations in 2026. With how many participating banks was UPI launched in 2016?
questions.explanation: PIB/NPCI (Aug 2026): UPI started with 21 banks in 2016 and had 741 live banks by July 2026. It handled about 24,162 crore transactions in FY 2025-26.

questions.q: Following NPCI's 2025 revision of UPI Lite limits, what is the maximum balance that can be held in a UPI Lite wallet?
questions.explanation: Following RBI's Dec 2024 policy, the UPI Lite limits are ₹1,000 per transaction and a maximum wallet balance of ₹5,000 (still in force as of Aug 2026).

questions.q: A CBDC (e₹)-based 'Digital Food Coupon' pilot under the Public Distribution System, which issues food subsidy as programmable digital-rupee coupons redeemable at Fair Price Shops, was inaugurated by Amit Shah on 15 February 2026 in which State or UT?
questions.explanation: 15 Feb 2026 (PIB): Amit Shah inaugurated the CBDC digital food coupon pilot in Gujarat. A CBDC-based PMGKAY pilot followed in Puducherry on 26 Feb 2026.

questions.q: Which RBI platform, which settles tokenised financial assets in wholesale CBDC, has been used for tokenised certificates of deposit and is linked to SEBI's 2026 'Demat 2.0' tokenised-bond pilot?
questions.explanation: RBI's Unified Markets Interface (UMI), announced in Oct 2025, had processed about 248 tokenised CD deals by Sep 2026. Demat 2.0 links to UMI for atomic settlement.

questions.q: In September 2026, which state-owned lender became the first issuer of tokenised corporate bonds under SEBI's 'Demat 2.0' pilot, with the funds leg settled in the RBI's wholesale CBDC?
questions.explanation: SEBI, Sep 2026: REC was the first issuer on 7 Sep 2026 (₹500 crore), followed by L&T (₹500 crore) and IIFL (₹25 crore). The total was ₹1,025 crore.

questions.q: The Unified Lending Interface (ULI), which had 64 lenders onboarded by December 2025, has been developed by which entity?
questions.explanation: RBIH developed ULI, earlier called the Public Tech Platform for Frictionless Credit. As of 12 Dec 2025 it had 64 lenders (41 banks and 23 NBFCs), per RBI's Trend & Progress report.

questions.q: To curb phishing, RBI directed banks to migrate their websites to the exclusive '.bank.in' domain by 31 October 2025. Which institution acts as the exclusive registrar for this domain?
questions.explanation: RBI circular, 22 Apr 2025: banks register '.bank.in' domains through IDRBT, the exclusive registrar. Non-bank financial entities are to use '.fin.in'.

questions.q: 'MuleHunter.AI', an AI/ML solution developed by the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub and deployed by several banks, is primarily used to detect:
options: Mule bank accounts used to route fraud proceeds
questions.explanation: RBIH's MuleHunter.AI uses AI/ML to flag mule accounts that are used to layer and divert cyber-fraud money.

questions.q: The Smart Registry of the Digital Payments Intelligence Platform (DPIP), a shared fraud-intelligence system, went live with eight banks on 1 September 2026. Which entity operates DPIP?
questions.explanation: GFF, Sep 2026: IDPIC MD & CEO K. Satyanarayana Raju said the Smart Registry went live on 1 Sep with 8 banks. About 25 more banks will join, and real-time transaction scoring comes in Phase 2.

questions.q: Under RBI's revised framework on fraudulent electronic banking transactions (issued 24 June 2026, applicable from 1 January 2027), an individual customer who suffers a loss of up to ₹50,000 can receive compensation of:
options: 75% of the net loss or ₹30,000, whichever is lower
85% of the net loss or ₹25,000, whichever is lower
50% of the net loss or ₹20,000, whichever is higher
questions.explanation: RBI, June 2026: compensation is 85% of the net loss or ₹25,000, whichever is lower, once in a lifetime. The fraud must be reported to the bank and to 1930/NCRP within 5 days.

questions.q: Under RBI's 'Authentication Mechanisms for Digital Payment Transactions Directions, 2025', effective 1 April 2026, digital payments need two factors of authentication. For transactions other than card-present ones, at least one factor must be:
questions.explanation: RBI Directions (issued 25 Sep 2025, effective 1 Apr 2026) require 2FA with at least one dynamic factor. SMS-OTP is not abolished, and risk-based checks are allowed.

questions.q: In March 2026, RBI granted final authorisation as a Payment Aggregator to Dreamplug Paytech Solutions Pvt Ltd. This entity runs the payments business of which fintech?
questions.explanation: 11 Mar 2026: CRED, registered as Dreamplug Paytech Solutions, received final PA authorisation about two years after in-principle approval (Apr 2024). It already held a PPI licence.

questions.q: In August 2026, Pluxee India received RBI authorisation to operate as a 'PA-O' and a 'PA-P'. What does 'PA-P' stand for under RBI's payment aggregator framework?
questions.explanation: Pluxee India was authorised on 3 Aug 2026 as a PA for online (PA-O) and physical point-of-sale (PA-P) payments. PA-CB is the cross-border category.

questions.q: As per the RBI's Digital Payments Index (RBI-DPI) released in February 2026, what was the index value for September 2025 (base: March 2018 = 100)?
questions.explanation: RBI statement, 12 Feb 2026: RBI-DPI rose to 516.76 for Sep 2025 from 493.22 in Mar 2025, driven by Payment Performance and Payment Enablers.

questions.q: As per the PMJDY progress report (data as on 16 September 2026), the total number of beneficiaries under Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana stood at approximately:
questions.explanation: PMJDY portal (as on 16 Sep 2026): 59.31 crore beneficiaries with deposits of about Rs 3.20 lakh crore; the count was 57.11 crore in Nov 2025 (DFS Annual Report 2025-26).

questions.q: As per 2026 PMJDY data, women account holders make up roughly what share of all Jan Dhan accounts?
questions.explanation: PMJDY portal (16 Sep 2026): 33.04 crore of 59.31 crore beneficiaries are women (about 55.7%), and about 78% of accounts are rural/semi-urban.

questions.q: The RuPay debit card issued to a PMJDY account holder carries built-in accidental insurance cover of how much for accounts opened after 28 August 2018?
questions.explanation: Cover is Rs 2 lakh, or Rs 1 lakh for accounts opened before 28.08.2018 (DFS Annual Report 2025-26).

questions.q: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) gives life cover of Rs 2 lakh for death due to any cause. What are its annual premium and its age group for joining?
questions.explanation: The premium is Rs 436 a year (raised from Rs 330 from 1 June 2022) and the age group is 18-50; there were about 25.79 crore enrolments by Nov 2025 (DFS AR 2025-26).

questions.q: Under Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY), what is the cover for partial permanent disability caused by an accident, and what is the annual premium?
questions.explanation: PMSBY (age 18-70) pays Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or total disability and Rs 1 lakh for partial permanent disability, for Rs 20 a year; about 55.32 crore enrolments by Nov 2025 (DFS AR 2025-26).

questions.q: In April 2026, PFRDA announced that gross enrolments under Atal Pension Yojana (APY) had crossed which milestone?
questions.explanation: PFRDA press release, 22 Apr 2026: APY crossed 9 crore gross enrolments on 21 Apr 2026, and FY 2025-26 had a record 1.35 crore enrolments.

questions.q: In January 2026, the Union Cabinet approved continuing Atal Pension Yojana, along with funding for promotional and developmental activities and gap funding, up to which year?
questions.explanation: Cabinet decision, 21 Jan 2026 (PIB): APY continues up to FY 2030-31; over 8.66 crore subscribers had enrolled as of 19 Jan 2026.

questions.q: Which of the following statements about Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is NOT correct?
options: It guarantees a monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after age 60
Income-tax payers can newly enrol in it
It is open to Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years
questions.explanation: Since 1 Oct 2022, people who are or have been income-tax payers cannot join APY (repeated in PFRDA's 22 April 2026 release).

questions.q: Under PM Mudra Yojana, the 'Tarun Plus' category covers what size of loan, for borrowers who have taken and fully repaid earlier Tarun loans?
options: Above Rs 5 lakh up to Rs 15 lakh
Above Rs 10 lakh up to Rs 25 lakh
Above Rs 10 lakh up to Rs 20 lakh
Above Rs 20 lakh up to Rs 50 lakh
questions.explanation: Gazette notification of 24 Oct 2024 (DFS AR 2025-26). The bands are Shishu up to Rs 50,000; Kishor Rs 50,000-5 lakh; Tarun Rs 5-10 lakh; Tarun Plus Rs 10-20 lakh.

questions.q: Guarantee cover for PMMY (Mudra) loans of up to Rs 20 lakh comes from which fund, and who is its trustee?
options: CGFMU; National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company (NCGTC)
questions.explanation: The Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units is held by NCGTC, which is wholly owned by the Government of India; live guarantees stood at Rs 5.60 lakh crore on 30.11.2025 (DFS AR 2025-26).

questions.q: As per MUDRA data, roughly how much was sanctioned under PM Mudra Yojana in FY 2025-26?
questions.explanation: mudra.org.in: 5.00 crore loans and Rs 6.14 lakh crore sanctioned in FY26, against Rs 5.52 lakh crore in FY25 and Rs 5.41 lakh crore in FY24.

questions.q: Under the Stand-Up India scheme (loans of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for greenfield enterprises), the margin money requirement was cut from 'up to 25%' of project cost to:
questions.explanation: A Budget 2021-22 change set the margin at up to 15%, but the borrower must still bring at least 10% (DFS AR 2025-26); loans are secured under CGFSIL, the Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Stand-Up India Loans (standupmitra.in).

questions.q: As on 31 March 2025, about how many loan accounts had been sanctioned under Stand-Up India since its launch on 5 April 2016?
questions.explanation: DFS AR 2025-26: 2,75,291 accounts with Rs 62,791.93 crore sanctioned, of which women (general) held about 2.05 lakh; the scheme was operational till March 2025.

questions.q: Union Budget 2025-26 announced a new scheme for 5 lakh first-time women, SC and ST entrepreneurs. What is the maximum term loan it offers?
questions.explanation: Budget speech, 1 Feb 2025 (para 32): term loans of up to Rs 2 crore over the next five years, building on the Stand-Up India experience.

questions.q: Under PM Vishwakarma (Ministry of MSME, launched 17 September 2023, covering 18 traditional trades), how is collateral-free credit provided?
options: Rs 2 lakh and Rs 3 lakh in two tranches at 7% interest
Rs 50,000 and Rs 1 lakh in two tranches at 4% interest
Rs 1 lakh and Rs 2 lakh in two tranches at 5% interest
A single loan of Rs 3 lakh at 6% interest
questions.explanation: Rs 1 lakh (18 months) plus Rs 2 lakh (30 months) at 5%, with MoMSME's interest subvention capped at 8%; there is also a Rs 15,000 toolkit incentive and a Rs 500/day training stipend (pmvishwakarma.gov.in).

questions.q: Under the restructured PM SVANidhi scheme, whose lending period now runs till 31 March 2030, what are the three loan tranches?
questions.explanation: Under the Cabinet restructuring (2025), the 1st tranche rose from Rs 10k to Rs 15k and the 2nd from Rs 20k to Rs 25k, while the 3rd stays at Rs 50k; MoHUA and DFS now run it jointly (DFS AR 2025-26).

questions.q: Street vendors who repay their second PM SVANidhi loan can get a UPI-linked RuPay credit card. What is its credit limit?
questions.explanation: DFS AR 2025-26: the card has a Rs 30,000 limit and a partial guarantee with 75% risk-sharing; the SVANidhi portal showed about 1.22 crore loans sanctioned by Sep 2026.

questions.q: Under the Prime Minister's Internship Scheme, run by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, how is the Rs 5,000 monthly assistance to an intern funded?
options: Rs 4,500 by Government + Rs 500 by company
Rs 2,500 by Government + Rs 2,500 by company
Entirely by the host company from CSR funds
Rs 4,000 by Government + Rs 1,000 by company
questions.explanation: PMIS portal: Rs 4,500 a month comes from the Government by DBT and Rs 500 from the company (out of its CSR funds); interns also get a one-time Rs 6,000 grant and PMJJBY/PMSBY cover for the 12-month internship.

questions.q: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana, launched on 15 August 2025, has an outlay of about ____ and aims to help create ____ jobs.
questions.explanation: pmvbry.labour.gov.in: Rs 99,446 crore outlay to help create more than 3.5 crore jobs (1 Aug 2025 to 31 Jul 2027). This is the Employment Linked Incentive scheme, run by the Ministry of Labour & Employment through EPFO; first-time employees get up to Rs 15,000.

questions.q: PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana, launched on 11 October 2025, covers how many districts and has what annual outlay?
questions.explanation: Cabinet (July 2025): Rs 24,000 crore a year for six years from 2025-26 in 100 low-performing districts, combining 36 schemes of 11 departments for about 1.7 crore farmers.

questions.q: Union Budget 2026-27 proposed 'SHE-Marts', community-owned retail outlets within cluster-level federations that help rural women move from credit-based livelihoods to owning enterprises. What does 'SHE' stand for?
questions.explanation: Budget speech, 1 Feb 2026 (para 84): Self-Help Entrepreneur (SHE) Marts, building on the success of the Lakhpati Didi programme.

questions.q: To build 'Champion MSMEs', the Union Budget 2026-27 proposed a dedicated SME Growth Fund of what size?
questions.explanation: Budget speech, 1 Feb 2026 (para 28-29): a Rs 10,000 crore SME Growth Fund, plus a Rs 2,000 crore top-up to the Self-Reliant India Fund set up in 2021.

questions.q: In January 2026, the Union Cabinet approved an equity infusion of how much into SIDBI, to be released in three tranches up to FY 2027-28?
questions.explanation: Cabinet, 21 Jan 2026 (PIB): Rs 5,000 crore in total, with Rs 3,000 crore in FY26 and Rs 1,000 crore each in FY27 and FY28, to keep SIDBI's CRAR healthy and make MSME credit cheaper.

questions.q: The Credit Guarantee Scheme for Exporters (CGSE), made operational on 1 December 2025, was designed to provide:
options: Up to Rs 20,000 crore of additional collateral-free working capital with 100% guarantee cover through NCGTC
Up to Rs 20,000 crore of term loans with 60% guarantee cover through CGTMSE
Up to Rs 25,060 crore of export credit with 75% guarantee cover through ECGC
Up to Rs 10,000 crore of pre-shipment credit with 85% guarantee cover through EXIM Bank
questions.explanation: DFS AR 2025-26: CGSE covers direct and indirect exporters, both MSME and non-MSME, with 100% NCGTC guarantee cover to member lending institutions; it was valid till 31 Mar 2026 or until Rs 20,000 crore of guarantees were issued.

questions.q: The Mutual Credit Guarantee Scheme for MSMEs (MCGS-MSME) gives lenders guarantee cover on MSME term loans for buying equipment or machinery up to what amount?
questions.explanation: DFS AR 2025-26: it covers term loans of up to Rs 100 crore from scheduled commercial banks, AIFIs and NBFCs for projects that involve buying equipment or machinery.

questions.q: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) was set up in 1988 as a non-statutory body. In which year did it get statutory powers through an Act of Parliament?
questions.explanation: SEBI was set up on 12 April 1988 and became a statutory body on 30 January 1992 under the SEBI Act, 1992.

questions.q: Tuhin Kanta Pandey took charge as Chairman of SEBI in March 2025. Which post was he holding just before this appointment?
questions.explanation: Tuhin Kanta Pandey, a 1987-batch IAS officer of the Odisha cadre, was Finance and Revenue Secretary. He took charge at SEBI on 1 March 2025 for three years, succeeding Madhabi Puri Buch.

questions.q: The Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT) hears appeals against the orders of which of the following regulators?
questions.explanation: SAT hears appeals against orders of SEBI, of IRDAI (Sec 110 of the Insurance Act) and of PFRDA (PFRDA Act, 2013). Its orders can be appealed in the Supreme Court. RBI orders do not go to SAT.

questions.q: Under IRDAI's 'Bima Trinity' initiative, what is 'Bima Vahak'?
options: An online grievance redressal portal for policyholders
A bundled product covering life, health, property and accident
A unified digital marketplace for buying and servicing policies
A women-centric insurance distribution channel at gram panchayat level
questions.explanation: The Bima Trinity has three parts. Bima Sugam is the marketplace, Bima Vistaar is the bundled product and Bima Vahak is the women-led field force. All three serve IRDAI's goal of 'Insurance for All by 2047'.

questions.q: As per IRDAI's Master Circular on Health Insurance (May 2024), insurers must decide on a cashless authorisation request and on final discharge authorisation within how much time, respectively?
questions.explanation: IRDAI's Master Circular of 29 May 2024 requires a cashless decision within 1 hour and discharge authorisation within 3 hours of the hospital's request.

questions.q: IRDAI has extended the 'free-look period' for life insurance policies, during which a policyholder can return the policy if not satisfied. What is the free-look period now?
questions.explanation: IRDAI's master circular on life insurance products (June 2024) extended the free-look period from 15 to 30 days from receipt of the policy document.

questions.q: The Union Budget 2025-26 proposed raising the FDI limit in the insurance sector for companies that invest their entire premium in India. The limit was proposed to be raised from:
questions.explanation: The FM announced this in Budget 2025-26 on 1 Feb 2025. It was enacted through the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (Amendment of Insurance Laws) Bill, 2025, which Parliament passed in December 2025 (Rajya Sabha on 17 Dec 2025).

questions.q: Under the Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) for Central Government employees, what is the full assured pension?
options: 60% of the average basic pay of the last 10 months, for minimum 25 years of qualifying service
50% of the average basic pay of the last 12 months, for minimum 30 years of qualifying service
50% of the last basic pay drawn, for minimum 20 years of qualifying service
50% of the average basic pay of the last 12 months, for minimum 25 years of qualifying service
questions.explanation: UPS was notified in January 2025 and took effect on 1 April 2025. Pay-outs are proportionate for 10 to 25 years of service, with a minimum of Rs 10,000 a month after 10 years.

questions.q: Under the Unified Pension Scheme, the employee contributes 10% of basic pay plus DA. How much does the Central Government contribute?
questions.explanation: Under UPS (effective 1 April 2025) the Centre contributes 18.5% of basic pay plus DA (10% to the individual corpus and 8.5% to a pool corpus), against 14% under NPS.

questions.q: NPS Vatsalya lets parents and guardians open pension accounts for minors. Under the revised PFRDA norms now in force, what is the minimum annual contribution under the scheme?
questions.explanation: NPS Vatsalya was launched on 18 Sept 2024 with a Rs 1,000 yearly minimum. PFRDA later revised the norms, and the account-opening and minimum annual contribution are now both Rs 250 (NPS CRA FAQs updated 16 June 2026).

questions.q: As per SEBI's mutual fund categorisation norms, a 'mid-cap' company is one ranked, by full market capitalisation, in which range?
questions.explanation: Under SEBI's Oct 2017 circular, large caps rank 1st to 100th, mid caps 101st to 250th and small caps 251st onward, based on AMFI's half-yearly list. This still applied as of Sept 2026.

questions.q: SEBI introduced 'Specialized Investment Funds' (SIF), a new asset class between mutual funds and PMS. What is the minimum investment per investor in an SIF?
questions.explanation: SEBI's SIF framework (Feb 2025 circular, operational from April 2025) sets a Rs 10 lakh minimum across a fund house's SIF strategies. PMS needs Rs 50 lakh and AIF Rs 1 crore.

questions.q: As part of its measures to curb speculation in equity index derivatives (effective November 2024), SEBI raised the minimum contract value at introduction to:
questions.explanation: SEBI's circular of 1 Oct 2024 raised the minimum from Rs 5-10 lakh to Rs 15 lakh. It also limited weekly expiry to one benchmark index per exchange.

questions.q: SEBI directed that all equity derivative contracts of an exchange must expire on either Tuesday or Thursday. From 1 September 2025, NSE's F&O contracts expire on which day?
questions.explanation: SEBI's May 2025 circular limited expiry days to Tuesday or Thursday. From 1 Sept 2025 NSE moved from Thursday to Tuesday and BSE from Tuesday to Thursday.

questions.q: Which company's IPO of about Rs 27,870 crore in October 2024 overtook LIC's 2022 issue to become the largest IPO in Indian history at the time?
questions.explanation: Hyundai Motor India's IPO of about Rs 27,870 crore (Oct 2024) beat LIC's issue of about Rs 21,000 crore from May 2022. It was still India's largest IPO in Sept 2026, ahead of NSE's Rs 22,569 crore issue.

questions.q: Which market infrastructure institution listed its shares on the stock exchange in August 2025 after its IPO?
questions.explanation: NSDL listed on BSE on 6 Aug 2025 after its offer-for-sale IPO of about Rs 4,012 crore. CDSL has been listed since 2017. NSE listed on BSE only on 24 Sept 2026.

questions.q: SEBI's framework for Small and Medium REITs (SM REITs), notified in March 2024, covers schemes with asset value in which range?
options: Rs 25 crore to less than Rs 250 crore
Rs 100 crore to less than Rs 1,000 crore
Rs 50 crore to less than Rs 500 crore
Rs 10 crore to less than Rs 100 crore
questions.explanation: SEBI (March 2024) created SM REITs for assets of Rs 50 crore to less than Rs 500 crore. This brought fractional-ownership real-estate platforms under regulation.

questions.q: NABARD was established on the recommendation of which committee?
questions.explanation: NABARD was set up on 12 July 1982 under the NABARD Act, 1981, on the recommendation of CRAFICARD headed by B. Sivaraman. It is headquartered in Mumbai.

questions.q: The Union Budget 2025-26 raised the credit guarantee cover for Micro and Small Enterprises under CGTMSE (set up by the Government of India and SIDBI) from Rs 5 crore to:
questions.explanation: Budget 2025-26 (Feb 2025) doubled MSE guarantee cover from Rs 5 crore to Rs 10 crore. Startup cover rose from Rs 10 crore to Rs 20 crore.

questions.q: India extends Lines of Credit to developing partner countries under the Indian Development and Economic Assistance Scheme (IDEAS). Through which institution are these Lines of Credit routed?
questions.explanation: EXIM Bank (est. 1 Jan 1982, HQ Mumbai) extends Government of India-supported Lines of Credit to partner countries under IDEAS.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT one of the All India Financial Institutions (AIFIs) regulated and supervised by the RBI?
questions.explanation: RBI regulates five AIFIs: EXIM Bank, NABARD, NHB, SIDBI and NaBFID (set up under the NaBFID Act, 2021). IFCI Ltd is registered with RBI as an NBFC.

questions.q: In July 2025, SEBI passed an interim order barring which US-based trading firm from the Indian securities market and impounding about Rs 4,843 crore over alleged manipulation of index options?
questions.explanation: SEBI's interim order of 3 July 2025 barred Jane Street group entities and impounded about Rs 4,843 crore of alleged unlawful gains from Bank Nifty options trades.

questions.q: The Reserve Bank of India, which began operations on 1 April 1935, was set up on the recommendations of which of the following?
questions.explanation: The RBI Act, 1934 followed the Royal Commission on Indian Currency and Finance (Hilton Young Commission, 1926).

questions.q: Rohit Jain took charge as a Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India on 4 May 2026. Whose term as Deputy Governor ended on 2 May 2026?
questions.explanation: RBI Deputy Governors page (Sept 2026) lists Rohit Jain as DG from 04.05.2026. T. Rabi Sankar's final extended term ran from 03.05.2025 to 02.05.2026.

questions.q: The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of the RBI is constituted under which section of the RBI Act, 1934?
questions.explanation: Section 45ZB provides for the six-member MPC. Section 45ZA covers the inflation target set by the Central Government.

questions.q: In March 2026 the Central Government notified the inflation target for April 2026 to March 2031. What is it?
options: CPI inflation of 4% with a tolerance band of +/-2%
CPI inflation of 4% with a tolerance band of +/-1.5%
WPI inflation of 4% with a tolerance band of +/-2%
CPI inflation of 3.5% with a tolerance band of +/-2%
questions.explanation: Notified on 25 March 2026 under Sec 45ZA: the target stays at 4% CPI (2%-6% band) until 31 March 2031 (The Hindu, TOI, CNBC TV18, 25 Mar 2026).

questions.q: As of September 2026 the policy repo rate is 5.25%. What are the Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) rate and the Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) rate respectively?
questions.explanation: The LAF corridor sits 25 bps either side of repo: SDF 5.00%, MSF and Bank Rate 5.50% (RBI website, 28 Sept 2026; repo unchanged at the Aug 2026 MPC).

questions.q: After the phased cut announced by RBI in June 2025 and completed by November 2025, the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) stands at:
questions.explanation: CRR (Sec 42 of the RBI Act) was cut from 4% to 3% in four 25 bps tranches (Sept-Nov 2025). The RBI website still showed 3% in Sept 2026, with SLR at 18%.

questions.q: Which of the following best distinguishes the Standing Deposit Facility (SDF), introduced in April 2022, from the fixed-rate reverse repo?
options: SDF is available only to NBFCs and primary dealers
SDF rate is set above the policy repo rate
SDF absorbs liquidity without RBI having to provide collateral in return
SDF is a term facility with a minimum tenor of 14 days
questions.explanation: SDF (enabled by the 2018 amendment to Sec 17 of the RBI Act) needs no collateral. It replaced the fixed reverse repo (now 3.35%) as the floor of the LAF corridor.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a tenor at which Government of India Treasury Bills are currently issued?
questions.explanation: GoI T-bills are issued at a discount in 91-, 182- and 364-day tenors. The 14-day intermediate T-bills are only for state governments.

questions.q: Commercial Paper (CP) in India can be issued for a minimum and maximum maturity of:
questions.explanation: Under RBI's CP directions, CP is issued in multiples of Rs 5 lakh with a maturity of 7 days to 1 year.

questions.q: In the Indian inter-bank money market, 'notice money' refers to funds borrowed or lent for a period of:
questions.explanation: Call money is overnight, notice money is 2-14 days and term money is 15 days to 1 year.

questions.q: With effect from 1 April 2012, RBI reduced the validity period of cheques, drafts, pay orders and banker's cheques to:
questions.explanation: RBI cut validity from 6 months to 3 months from the date of the instrument.

questions.q: Dishonour of a cheque for insufficiency of funds is a criminal offence under which section of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881?
questions.explanation: Under Sec 138 the penalty is imprisonment up to 2 years, a fine up to twice the cheque amount, or both.

questions.q: Under the Positive Pay System for the Cheque Truncation System, in effect since 1 January 2021, banks must enable the facility for all account holders issuing cheques of what amount and above?
questions.explanation: Positive Pay is enabled for cheques of Rs 50,000 and above, at the customer's discretion. Banks may make it mandatory for Rs 5 lakh and above.

questions.q: RBI moved cheque clearing under CTS from batch processing to 'Continuous Clearing and Settlement on Realisation' (Phase 1) with effect from:
questions.explanation: Phase 1 began on 4 Oct 2025: cheques presented 10 AM-4 PM, with drawee confirmation by 7 PM. Phase 2 (T+3 hours), due 3 Jan 2026, was postponed until further notice on 24 Dec 2025.

questions.q: Under RBI's early-warning framework for loans, an account whose principal or interest is overdue for 61 to 90 days is classified as:
questions.explanation: For loans, SMA-0 is up to 30 days, SMA-1 is 31-60 days and SMA-2 is 61-90 days overdue. Beyond 90 days the account becomes an NPA.

questions.q: The SARFAESI Act, 2002 does not apply where the amount due is less than what percentage of the outstanding principal and interest?
questions.explanation: Section 31(j) excludes cases where the amount due is below 20% of principal and interest. The Act also does not apply to loans below Rs 1 lakh (Sec 31(h)).

questions.q: In March 2020 the minimum amount of default for starting the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the IBC, 2016 was raised from Rs 1 lakh to:
questions.explanation: The threshold was raised to Rs 1 crore under Sec 4 of the IBC (24 March 2020). The MSME pre-pack scheme uses a Rs 10 lakh threshold.

questions.q: Under RBI's Basel III capital regulations, the minimum total capital (CRAR) an Indian bank must maintain, including the Capital Conservation Buffer, is:
questions.explanation: Minimum CRAR is 9% (the BCBS norm is 8%). Adding the 2.5% CCB gives 11.5%. The CET1 minimum is 5.5%, or 8% with the CCB.

questions.q: RBI's minimum Leverage Ratio requirement for Domestic Systemically Important Banks (D-SIBs) is:
questions.explanation: RBI requires a 4% leverage ratio for D-SIBs and 3.5% for other banks, against the Basel minimum of 3%.

questions.q: In RBI's D-SIB list released in December 2025, State Bank of India is placed in Bucket 4. What additional CET1 requirement applies to it?
questions.explanation: The 2 Dec 2025 list kept the 2024 buckets: SBI (Bucket 4, 0.80%), HDFC Bank (Bucket 2, 0.40%) and ICICI Bank (Bucket 1, 0.20%). This is on top of the CCB.

questions.q: Under RBI's revised Priority Sector Lending directions effective 1 April 2025, what is the target for lending to 'weaker sections' by domestic commercial banks?
questions.explanation: Under the PSL Master Directions 2025 the weaker-sections target is 12% (up from 10%). The overall target stays at 40% and agriculture at 18%.

questions.q: After RBI's 2025 revisions to PSL targets, which category of banks has the highest overall PSL target of 75% of ANBC?
options: Foreign banks with 20 or more branches
questions.explanation: RRBs stay at 75%. SFBs were cut from 75% to 60% (20 June 2025) and UCBs are at 60%. Domestic SCBs and large foreign banks are at 40% (PSL Master Directions 2025).

questions.q: Under the DICGC (Amendment) Act, 2021, when a bank is placed under all-inclusive directions, depositors must receive interim payment up to the insured limit within:
questions.explanation: The Act mandates payout within 90 days. Deposit cover has been Rs 5 lakh per depositor per bank since 4 Feb 2020 (DICGC).

questions.q: Under the Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, which came into force on 1 July 2026, the RBI Ombudsman can award compensation for consequential loss of up to:
questions.explanation: RB-IOS 2026 (issued Jan 2026, effective 1 July 2026) raised the cap from Rs 20 lakh to Rs 30 lakh, plus up to Rs 3 lakh for harassment or mental anguish (Rs 33 lakh in all).

questions.q: Under RBI's Scale-Based Regulation (SBR) framework for NBFCs, which layer is ideally expected to remain empty?
questions.explanation: SBR (effective 1 Oct 2022) has Base, Middle, Upper and Top layers. An NBFC moves to the Top Layer only if RBI sees extreme systemic risk.

questions.q: A Core Investment Company (CIC) must hold at least what share of its net assets as investments in, or loans to, group companies?
questions.explanation: CICs must hold at least 90% of net assets in group-company equity, preference shares, debt or loans. At least 60% must be equity in group companies.

questions.q: Which of the following currency notes is issued by the Government of India and not by the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.explanation: The Rs 1 note is issued by GoI and signed by the Finance Secretary. RBI issues all other notes under Sec 22 of the RBI Act, and GoI mints coins under the Coinage Act, 2011.

questions.q: Under the Minimum Reserve System (1957), RBI must hold gold coin, gold bullion and foreign securities worth at least Rs 200 crore. What is the minimum value of gold coin and bullion within this?
questions.explanation: The MRS replaced the proportional reserve system. Of the Rs 200 crore minimum reserve, at least Rs 115 crore must be in gold.

questions.q: Which of the following currency note presses is owned by Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Pvt Ltd (BRBNMPL), a wholly owned subsidiary of RBI?
questions.explanation: BRBNMPL runs the presses at Mysuru and Salboni. Nashik and Dewas belong to GoI's SPMCIL, which also runs the Narmadapuram paper mill.

questions.q: Which was the first bank of limited liability to be managed entirely by Indians, established in 1881 at Faizabad?
questions.explanation: Oudh (Awadh) Commercial Bank was founded in 1881. PNB (1894, Lahore) is called the first bank owned wholly by Indians with Indian capital.

questions.q: After the 'One State, One RRB' amalgamation effective 1 May 2025, the number of Regional Rural Banks in India fell from 43 to:
questions.explanation: 26 RRBs in 10 states were merged into 11, leaving 28 RRBs in 26 states and 2 UTs (Finance Ministry notification, April 2025).

questions.q: Which of the following public sector banks is INCORRECTLY matched with its headquarters?
questions.explanation: Punjab & Sind Bank is headquartered in New Delhi.

questions.q: 'Honours Your Trust' is the tagline of which public sector bank?
questions.explanation: It is UCO Bank's tagline (HQ Kolkata). Bank of India's tagline is 'Relationship beyond banking'.

questions.q: Deposit accounts that have not been operated for how many years are transferred by banks to RBI's Depositor Education and Awareness (DEA) Fund?
questions.explanation: Under Sec 26A of the BR Act (DEA Fund, 2014), unclaimed deposits of 10 years or more go to the Fund. Depositors can still claim them, and RBI's UDGAM portal helps them search.

questions.q: Under the Banking Laws (Amendment) Act, 2025, whose nomination provisions came into force on 1 November 2025, a depositor can nominate up to how many persons for a deposit account?
questions.explanation: Deposits can have up to four nominees, simultaneous or successive. Articles in safe custody and lockers allow only successive nomination (MoF, 23 Oct 2025).

questions.q: The 18th BRICS Summit, held on 12-13 September 2026 under India's chairship, took place at which venue?
questions.explanation: The 18th BRICS Summit (12-13 Sept 2026) was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. It adopted the New Delhi Declaration, which backed China's BRICS chairship in 2027.

questions.q: India's BRICS Chairship 2026 theme reads the acronym BRICS as 'Building for ______'. Fill in the blank.
questions.explanation: The theme of India's 2026 BRICS chairship, and of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi (Sept 2026), was 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.

questions.q: Where will the 2026 G20 Leaders' Summit, under the United States' G20 Presidency, be held in December 2026?
questions.explanation: The 2026 G20 summit (14-15 Dec 2026) is at Trump National Doral, Miami, Florida. The UK hosts the next one, in Manchester in 2027.

questions.q: The 26th Meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of State, held on 31 August-1 September 2026, was hosted by which city?
questions.explanation: Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan hosted the 26th SCO summit (31 Aug-1 Sept 2026). It adopted the Bishkek Declaration on the 25th Anniversary of the SCO. The 2025 summit was in Tianjin, China.

questions.q: COP31 (9-20 November 2026) will be held in Antalya, Türkiye, with Türkiye holding the COP Presidency. Under the hosting compromise, a minister from which country will preside over the negotiations?
questions.explanation: Türkiye's Murat Kurum is COP31 President. Australia's Chris Bowen is Vice-President and 'President of Negotiations'. COP32 will be in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, in 2027.

questions.q: The 2026 Annual Meetings of the IMF and the World Bank Group (October 2026) are being hosted by which city?
questions.explanation: The 2026 IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings are in Bangkok, Thailand, on 12-18 Oct 2026. The 2024 and 2025 meetings were in Washington, D.C., and the 2023 meetings in Marrakech.

questions.q: What was the theme of the World Economic Forum's 56th Annual Meeting held at Davos in January 2026?
questions.explanation: The theme of WEF Davos 2026 (Jan 2026) was 'A Spirit of Dialogue'. The 2025 theme was 'Collaboration for the Intelligent Age' and the 2024 theme was 'Rebuilding Trust'.

questions.q: The 14th Ministerial Conference (MC14) of the World Trade Organization was held in March 2026 in which city?
questions.explanation: WTO MC14 was held in Yaoundé, Cameroon, on 26-30 March 2026 and ended without a formal ministerial declaration. MC13 was held in Abu Dhabi in Feb 2024.

questions.q: In July 2026, India took up the Vice-Presidency of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) for the first time. Who represents India in this post for 2026-27?
questions.explanation: Vivek Aggarwal (IAS, 1994 batch) was elected FATF Vice-President for 2026-27 (PIB, 19 June 2026) and took office in July 2026. He is the first Indian to hold the post. The FATF President is Giles Thomson.

questions.q: Who was elected President of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly and took office in September 2026?
questions.explanation: Bangladesh's Khalilur Rahman was elected on 2 June 2026, beating Cyprus's Andreas Kakouris 99-91. He took office on 8 Sept 2026, succeeding Annalena Baerbock (80th session).

questions.q: Barham Salih took over as UN High Commissioner for Refugees on 1 January 2026, succeeding Filippo Grandi. He is a former President of which country?
questions.explanation: Barham Salih, a former President of Iraq, became the 12th UN High Commissioner for Refugees on 1 Jan 2026.

questions.q: Zou Jiayi, who assumed office on 16 January 2026 in succession to Jin Liqun, heads which multilateral development bank?
questions.explanation: Zou Jiayi became President of the Beijing-based AIIB on 16 Jan 2026, succeeding its founding President Jin Liqun.

questions.q: The 2025 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences, for explaining innovation-driven economic growth, was awarded to Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and whom?
questions.explanation: The Oct 2025 prize went half to Mokyr, and half jointly to Aghion and Howitt for the theory of sustained growth through 'creative destruction'. Acemoglu and Johnson won in 2024.

questions.q: Which banker was conferred the Padma Bhushan in the Trade & Industry category in the Padma Awards 2026?
questions.explanation: Uday Kotak received the Padma Bhushan 2026 for Trade & Industry (Padma awards announced Jan 2026). Parekh (2006) and Kamath (2008) received theirs earlier.

questions.q: Which of the following personalities received the Padma Vibhushan in 2026?
questions.explanation: Violinist N. Rajam was one of five Padma Vibhushan 2026 awardees, with Dharmendra, V.S. Achuthanandan (both posthumous), K.T. Thomas and P. Narayanan. Mammootty, Alka Yagnik and Vijay Amritraj received the Padma Bhushan 2026.

questions.q: India won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 by defeating which team in the final at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad, on 8 March 2026?
questions.explanation: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs (8 Mar 2026). India became the first team to win three T20 World Cup titles, the first to defend the title and the first to win it at home. Sanju Samson was Player of the Tournament.

questions.q: Which country won the 2026 FIFA World Cup, beating Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final at MetLife Stadium, New Jersey, on 19 July 2026?
questions.explanation: Spain won its second World Cup, and first since 2010, when Ferran Torres scored in the 106th minute (19 July 2026). France's Kylian Mbappé won the Golden Boot with 10 goals.

questions.q: 'Taiwan Travelogue', the winner of the International Booker Prize 2026, was written by whom?
questions.explanation: Yang Shuang-zi's novel, translated by Lin King, won on 19 May 2026. It was the first winner originally written in Mandarin. Banu Mushtaq's 'Heart Lamp' won in 2025.

questions.q: What was the theme of the 12th International Day of Yoga (21 June 2026), whose main national event was led by the PM in Kolkata?
options: Yoga for One Earth, One Health
questions.explanation: The IDY 2026 theme was 'Yoga for Healthy Ageing' (UN, June 2026). The PM led the national event from Red Road, Kolkata. The 2025 theme was 'Yoga for One Earth, One Health'.

questions.q: Exercise 'Nomadic Elephant', whose 18th edition began at Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand, in September 2026, is a joint military exercise between India and which country?
questions.explanation: Nomadic Elephant is the India-Mongolia army exercise. Its 18th edition began at Pithoragarh (PIB, 21 Sept 2026). India's exercises with the other options are Prabal Dostyk (Kazakhstan), Khanjar (Kyrgyzstan) and Dustlik (Uzbekistan).

questions.q: Under RBI's incentive scheme for currency distribution and exchange by bank branches, what incentive is paid for exchanging soiled notes?
options: Rs 10 per packet for denominations of Rs 50 and below
Rs 2 per packet for denominations of Rs 50 and below
Rs 2 per piece for denominations of Rs 100 and below
Rs 5 per packet for all denominations
questions.explanation: RBI Master Direction on Incentives for Currency Distribution & Exchange (1 Apr 2026): Rs 2 per packet for exchanging soiled notes of Rs 50 and below, and Rs 2 per piece for adjudicating mutilated notes.

questions.q: Under RBI's currency distribution incentive framework, the base incentive for distributing coins is Rs 65 per bag. What additional incentive is paid for coin distribution in rural and semi-urban areas?
questions.explanation: RBI Master Direction on Incentives for Currency Distribution & Exchange (1 Apr 2026): an extra Rs 10 per bag for rural and semi-urban areas, backed by a Concurrent Auditor certificate. That makes Rs 75 per bag in total.

questions.q: As per RBI's directions on counterfeit notes, a bank branch must file an FIR with the police immediately when the number of counterfeit notes detected in a single transaction is at least:
questions.explanation: RBI Master Direction on Counterfeit Notes (1 Apr 2026): an FIR for 5 or more pieces in one transaction; up to 4 pieces go in a consolidated monthly report to the police. Notes are stamped 'COUNTERFEIT BANKNOTE IMPOUNDED' and are never returned to the tenderer.

questions.q: Bank branches must exchange soiled notes over the counter, free of charge, when a person tenders up to:
options: 10 pieces with a maximum value of Rs 5,000 per day
20 pieces with a maximum value of Rs 10,000 per day
20 pieces with a maximum value of Rs 5,000 per day
50 pieces with a maximum value of Rs 25,000 per day
questions.explanation: RBI Master Direction on Facility for Exchange of Notes and Coins (1 Apr 2026): up to 20 pieces worth at most Rs 5,000 a day are exchanged free. Larger lots are accepted against a receipt and credited within 7 days.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT one of the seven 'Sutras' in RBI's FREE-AI framework for the financial sector (August 2025)?
questions.explanation: FREE-AI report (13 Aug 2025; committee chaired by Dr Pushpak Bhattacharyya). The 7 sutras are Trust is the Foundation, People First, Innovation over Restraint, Fairness & Equity, Accountability, Understandable by Design, and Safety, Resilience & Sustainability.

questions.q: Under RBI's medium-term strategy framework 'Utkarsh 2029', released in April 2026, the initiative 'Sa-Mudra' is aimed at:
options: Modernising currency management by digitising manual processes
questions.explanation: RBI released Utkarsh 2029 on 10 Apr 2026. Under it, Project Sa-Mudra modernises currency management systems (BusinessLine, Apr 2026).

questions.q: RBI's 'Mission SAKSHAM', launched in April 2026 to train about 1.40 lakh participants, is a capacity-building initiative for:
questions.explanation: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra launched Mission SAKSHAM on 28 Apr 2026. It will train about 1.40 lakh board members, managers and staff of Urban Co-operative Banks (GKToday / Business Standard, Apr 2026).

questions.q: 'Pension Sahayak' is an AI-enabled grievance redressal platform launched in June 2026 that lets subscribers lodge complaints by voice and WhatsApp. Which body launched it?
options: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
questions.explanation: PFRDA launched the 'PFRDA Pension Sahayak' portal for NPS and pension grievances on 22 Jun 2026 (ET / Moneycontrol, Jun 2026).

questions.q: The Rs 33,660 crore BHAVYA scheme of DPIIT, which aims to develop 100 plug-and-play industrial parks, stands for:
questions.explanation: BHAVYA stands for Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojana, a Rs 33,660 crore DPIIT scheme for 100 industrial parks. Piyush Goyal launched the BHAVYA portal in June 2026 (PIB / DD India, Jun 2026).

questions.q: How many characters make up the Unique Transaction Reference (UTR) number of an RTGS transaction?
questions.explanation: An RTGS UTR has 22 characters and a NEFT UTR has 16. RTGS has a minimum of Rs 2 lakh and no upper limit.

questions.q: Which entity operates the Bharat Bill Payment System (BBPS)?
questions.explanation: BBPS is run by NBBL, a wholly owned NPCI subsidiary. RBI itself operates RTGS and NEFT.

questions.q: Matsya 6000, India's first indigenous crewed submersible under the Deep Ocean Mission (Samudrayaan), is designed to carry how many aquanauts to a depth of 6,000 m?
questions.explanation: Matsya 6000 was built by NIOT Chennai (Ministry of Earth Sciences) and carries 3 humans to 6,000 m. A 500 m shallow-water dive was planned for 2026.

questions.q: Under the Lead Bank Scheme, which forum operates at the block level to coordinate credit delivery?
questions.explanation: The Lead Bank Scheme has the SLBC at state level, the DCC and DLRC at district level, and the Block Level Bankers' Committee (BLBC) at block level.

questions.q: Under the PML Rules, the aggregate of all credits in a 'small account' in a financial year must not exceed:
questions.explanation: Small account limits: credits up to Rs 1 lakh a year, withdrawals up to Rs 10,000 a month, and a balance of at most Rs 50,000 at any time.

questions.q: The Income-tax Act, 2025 came into force on 1 April 2026 and uses a single 'tax year' concept. Which form has Form 130 replaced?
questions.explanation: Under the Income-tax Act 2025 and Rules 2026 (from 1 Apr 2026), Form 130 replaces Form 16 (the salary TDS certificate) and Form 168 replaces Form 26AS (ET, Feb 2026).

questions.q: GST 2.0 was approved at the 56th GST Council meeting (3 Sep 2025) and took effect on 22 Sep 2025. What rate structure did it introduce?
options: Three slabs of 5%, 12% and 18%, plus 28% with cess
Two main slabs of 5% and 12%, plus a special 28% rate
Two main slabs of 8% and 18%, plus a special 40% rate
Two main slabs of 5% and 18%, plus a special 40% rate on sin/luxury goods
questions.explanation: The 56th GST Council (3 Sep 2025) moved to 5% and 18% slabs plus a 40% demerit rate, and exempted individual life and health insurance.

questions.q: Which statement about the 16th Finance Commission (award period 2026-31), whose report was tabled on 1 Feb 2026, is correct?
options: Chaired by Arvind Panagariya; states' share kept at 41% and 'contribution to GDP' added as a new criterion
Chaired by Arvind Panagariya; states' share reduced to 40%
Chaired by N.K. Singh; states' share raised to 42%
Chaired by Y.V. Reddy; states' share kept at 41%
questions.explanation: The 16th FC, chaired by Arvind Panagariya, kept vertical devolution at 41% and added a GDP-contribution criterion. Its report was tabled with Budget 2026-27 on 1 Feb 2026 (ET / Financial Express, Feb 2026).

questions.q: On which date is the India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement scheduled to come into force?
questions.explanation: Piyush Goyal announced on 21 Sep 2026, after ratification, that the FTA takes effect on 20 Oct 2026, giving 100% of Indian exports duty-free access (Reuters / The Hindu, Sep 2026).

questions.q: The India-Oman Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) entered into force on:
questions.explanation: The CEPA was signed in Muscat on 18 Dec 2025 and came into force on 1 Jun 2026, giving about 99% of Indian exports duty-free access (ET / The Hindu, Jun 2026).

questions.q: What was RBI's Financial Inclusion Index (FI-Index) for March 2026, and which of its three parameters carries the highest weight?
questions.explanation: The FI-Index rose 4.48% to 70.0 in Mar 2026 from 67.0 (RBI, 16 Jul 2026). Weights are Access 35%, Usage 45% and Quality 20%.

questions.q: Sarnath was inscribed as India's 45th UNESCO World Heritage Site on 25 July 2026 at the 48th session of the World Heritage Committee. Where was that session held?
questions.explanation: The 48th WHC session was held in Busan in Jul 2026. The 'Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath' was inscribed on 25 Jul 2026 as India's 45th site (PIB / UNESCO, Jul 2026).

questions.q: Glaw Lake, designated India's 101st Ramsar site on 3 August 2026, became the first Ramsar wetland of which state?
questions.explanation: Glaw Lake is in Lohit district of Arunachal Pradesh, inside Kamlang Tiger Reserve. Its designation made it the state's first Ramsar site and India's 101st (DD News, 3 Aug 2026).

questions.q: Which refining CPSE, a subsidiary of Indian Oil Corporation, was granted Navratna status in June 2026, becoming India's 28th Navratna?
questions.explanation: CPCL became the 28th Navratna CPSE on 19 Jun 2026. GRSE also received Navratna status in June 2026 (ET / Upstox, Jun 2026).

questions.q: What is the reference date for Census 2027, India's first digital census, in most of the country (excluding snow-bound areas)?
questions.explanation: The reference date is 00:00 hrs on 1 Mar 2027, and 1 Oct 2026 for snow-bound areas (MHA notification, Jun 2025). Census 2027 also includes caste enumeration.
